title: The Ammonix ECG Agent: A Local Specialized AI Agent to Transparently Read and Discuss 12-Lead Electrocardiograms
summary: Automated interpretation of the 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) is a high-stakes multi-label classification problem, and one that carries ambiguity the waveform alone often cannot resolve. A patient's presentation, history, and medications can each change the reading, information a deployed ECG classifier cannot ask for. Here we report the Ammonix ECG Agent, the clinical instantiation of the agent architecture introduced in our companion Foundation paper. At inference, the agent decomposes each 12-lead resting ECG into as many as 26,490 mechanistic features through its ECG tokenizer; localizes the recording in a Knowledge Universe through a classifier swarm; applies Skills (deterministic domain constraints, learned rules targeting recurrent classifier failure modes, and clarification questions); and produces a diagnostic interpretation through a frozen vision-language model that can request patient context and incorporate it into its interpretation. The tokenizer is fixed by cardiac biophysics, the classifier swarm is fitted by supervised learning on physician-documented diagnoses and frozen at deployment, and the language model is frozen. Only the Skill layer is trained, as symbolic rules in the harness rather than model weights, by Retrospective Harness Optimization with Verifiable Rewards (RHO-VR). Placing a fixed, biophysics-constrained representation before the classifier, rather than learning an opaque convolutional embedding end to end, has two independent advantages. First, the agent's explanations are auditable by design, with each claim about the recording meant to trace to a named, deterministically computed feature or a marked region of the trace. Second, because its representation is supplied rather than learned, the agent should need far fewer labeled cases. On three of the six diagnoses tested (atrial fibrillation, right bundle branch block, and Brugada syndrome), the mechanistic model leads a self-supervised convolutional neural network (CNN) on the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) at every training size, most widely with the fewest labeled cases. On two of the other three the CNN leads with the fewest labeled cases before the mechanistic model overtakes it. We report two experiments. On a 17-diagnosis PhysioNet task (5,108 recordings), adding an unconstrained language model to a gradient-boosted classifier lowers precision from 0.68 to 0.60 and micro-averaged F1 (micro-F1) from 0.72 to 0.69, whereas the same frozen model applying validated Skills reaches micro-F1 0.80 and 57% exact match, against 0.73 for a classifier retrained on the additional labeled data. In a scale-up to 32 diagnoses on 63,256 recordings drawn predominantly from MIMIC-IV-ECG, the classifier swarm reaches a mean AUROC of 0.950, and 0.929 against same-source negatives only. The agent runs fully offline on a single consumer laptop and supports interactive case review with the supervising clinician.
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

AI.tldr: Ammonix ECG Agent通过生物物理约束特征和技能层，在少标签下实现可审计的12导联心电图诊断，32诊断AUROC达0.950。
AI.motivation: 自动心电图判读是高风险的多元分类问题，波形本身常存在歧义，需结合患者病史与用药等信息；已部署的分类器无法主动询问这些信息，且端到端深度学习模型缺乏可解释性，且依赖大量标注数据。
AI.method: 研究提出Ammonix ECG Agent，推理时将12导联静息心电图分解为最多26,490个机制特征，经分类器群定位到知识宇宙，并应用技能层（确定性约束、学习规则、澄清问题），由冻结的视觉语言模型生成诊断解读并可请求患者背景。分词器由心脏生物物理固定，分类器群在医生诊断上监督学习后冻结，仅技能层通过RHO-VR训练。在两个数据集上评估：PhysioNet 17诊断任务（5,108份记录）和扩展至32诊断的63,256份记录（主要来自MIMIC-IV-ECG）。主要终点为AUROC、micro-F1、精确匹配率等。
AI.result: 在6个诊断中，房颤、右束支传导阻滞和Brugada综合征三个诊断上，机制模型在所有训练规模下AUROC均领先自监督CNN，且在最少标签时优势最明显；另三个诊断中CNN在最少标签时领先，但随后被机制模型超越。PhysioNet任务中，无约束语言模型加入梯度提升分类器使精确率从0.68降至0.60，micro-F1从0.72降至0.69；而冻结模型应用验证技能后micro-F1达0.80，精确匹配率57%，优于重新训练分类器的0.73。扩展至32诊断时，分类器群平均AUROC为0.950，仅对同源负样本时为0.929。
AI.conclusion: Ammonix ECG Agent通过生物物理约束表示和技能层，在少标签下实现可审计的心电图诊断，性能优于传统分类器和无约束语言模型，且可离线运行于单台笔记本电脑，支持临床医生交互式复核。其临床意义在于提升心电图AI的可解释性和数据效率，但需进一步外部验证和前瞻性研究确认其泛化能力与临床影响。

summary_zh: 12导联心电图（ECG）的自动解读是一个高风险的多标签分类问题，并且存在仅凭波形往往无法解决的模糊性。患者的临床表现、病史和用药情况均可能改变判读结果，而这些信息是已部署的ECG分类器无法主动获取的。在此我们报告Ammonix ECG Agent，这是在我们配套的Foundation论文中引入的智能体架构的临床实例化。在推理时，该智能体通过其ECG分词器将每个12导联静息ECG分解为多达26,490个机制性特征；通过分类器集群在知识宇宙中定位该记录；应用技能（确定性领域约束、针对反复出现的分类器失败模式的学习规则以及澄清性问题）；并通过一个冻结的视觉-语言模型生成诊断性解读，该模型可以请求患者背景信息并将其纳入解读。分词器由心脏生物物理学固定，分类器集群通过在医生记录的诊断上进行监督学习拟合并在部署时冻结，语言模型也是冻结的。只有技能层通过可验证奖励的回顾性框架优化（RHO-VR）进行训练，作为框架中的符号规则而非模型权重。将固定的、受生物物理学约束的表示置于分类器之前，而非端到端地学习不透明的卷积嵌入，具有两个独立的优势。第一，智能体的解释在设计上就是可审计的，关于记录的每个声明都旨在追溯到命名的、确定性计算的特征或波形的标记区域。第二，由于其表示是提供的而非学习的，智能体所需的标注病例应远少得多。在测试的六种诊断中的三种（心房颤动、右束支传导阻滞和Brugada综合征）上，机制性模型在每个训练规模下均在受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）上领先于自监督卷积神经网络（CNN），在标注病例最少时优势最广泛。在另外三种中的两种上，CNN在标注病例最少时领先，之后机制性模型反超。我们报告两项实验。在一个17种诊断的PhysioNet任务（5,108份记录）上，将无约束的语言模型添加到梯度提升分类器会使精确率从0.68降至0.60，微平均F1（micro-F1）从0.72降至0.69，而同一冻结模型应用经过验证的技能达到micro-F1 0.80和57%的精确匹配，相比之下，在额外标注数据上重新训练的分类器为0.73。在扩展到主要来自MIMIC-IV-ECG的63,256份记录上的32种诊断时，分类器集群达到平均AUROC 0.950，仅针对同源阴性时达到0.929。该智能体在单台消费级笔记本电脑上完全离线运行，并支持与主管临床医生的交互式病例审查。

title: Методы машинного обучения в обработке медицинской информации при мерцательной аритмии
summary: Мерцательная аритмия (МА) – одно из наиболее распространённых нарушений сердечного ритма, представляющее серьёзную медико-социальную проблему. В качестве источников данных для моделей машинного обучения используются различные типы медицинской информации. Цель исследования – сравнить современные методы машинного обучения, применяемые для обработки медицинской информации при мерцательной аритмии. Для построения модели прогнозирования использовались восемь алгоритмов ML. Эффективность модели оценивалась на основе идентификации, калибровки и клинического применения. Построена модель с наиболее значимыми переменными, при этом наилучшие результаты показал алгоритм XGBoost, достигший AUC 0,891 (0,873–0,888) при внутренней проверке и 0,769 (0,756–0,782) при внешней проверке. К ключевым прогностическим факторам относились возраст, уровень мочевины в крови, сатурация и вес. Разработанная модель машинного обучения для прогнозирования риска мерцательной аритмии подтвердила ее потенциал как клинически надежного инструмента. Интерпретируемая модель позволяет врачам лучше понять причины развития мерцательной аритмии, помогает врачам принимать упреждающие меры и улучшает исход лечения пациентов Atrial fibrillation (MA) is one of the most common cardiac arrhythmias, which is a serious medical and social problem. Various types of medical information are used as data sources for machine learning models. The aim of the study is to compare modern machine learning methods used to process medical information in atrial fibrillation. Eight ML algorithms were used to build the prediction model. The effectiveness of the model was assessed based on identification, calibration, and clinical application. A model with the most significant variables was constructed, while the XGBoost algorithm showed the best results, reaching an AUC of 0.891 (0.873–0.888) with internal verification and 0.769 (0.756–0.782) with external verification. The key prognostic factors included age, blood urea levels, saturation, and weight. The developed machine learning model for predicting the risk of atrial fibrillation has confirmed its potential as a clinically reliable tool. The interpreted model allows doctors to better understand the causes of atrial fibrillation, helps doctors take proactive measures, and improves patient treatment outcomes
journal: СИСТЕМНЫЙ АНАЛИЗ И УПРАВЛЕНИЕ В БИОМЕДИЦИНСКИХ СИСТЕМАХ

AI.tldr: 在房颤风险预测中，八种机器学习算法比较显示XGBoost表现最佳，内部验证AUC 0.891，外部验证AUC 0.769，关键预测因子为年龄、血尿素、血氧饱和度和体重。

AI.method: 研究比较八种机器学习算法构建房颤预测模型，数据源为多种医疗信息。模型效能从识别、校准和临床应用三方面评估。采用内部验证和外部验证，以AUC为主要指标，并筛选最具显著性变量。
AI.result: XGBoost算法表现最佳，内部验证AUC为0.891（95%CI 0.873–0.888），外部验证AUC为0.769（95%CI 0.756–0.782）。关键预测因子包括年龄、血尿素水平、血氧饱和度和体重。摘要未报告校准指标和临床应用的详细结果。
AI.conclusion: 基于XGBoost的房颤风险预测模型具有临床可靠性潜力，可解释模型有助于医生理解房颤原因并采取预防措施。但外部验证AUC中等，需进一步在前瞻性队列中验证，且摘要未提供校准和临床净获益数据，推广前应谨慎评估。

summary_zh: 背景：心房颤动（AF）是最常见的心律失常之一，构成严重的医学和社会问题。方法：各种类型的医学信息被用作机器学习模型的数据源。目的：本研究旨在比较用于处理心房颤动医学信息的现代机器学习方法。结果：使用八种ML算法构建预测模型。基于识别、校准和临床应用评估模型的效能。构建了包含最显著变量的模型，其中XGBoost算法表现最佳，内部验证时AUC达到0.891（0.873–0.888），外部验证时为0.769（0.756–0.782）。关键预后因素包括年龄、血尿素水平、血氧饱和度和体重。结论：所开发的心房颤动风险预测机器学习模型证实了其作为临床可靠工具的潜力。该可解释模型使医生能够更好地理解心房颤动的发生原因，帮助医生采取预防性措施，并改善患者的治疗结局。

title: Optimal duration of anticoagulation after successful catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: insights from recent randomized trials.
summary: The optimal duration of oral anticoagulation (OAC) after successful catheter ablation (CA) for atrial fibrillation (AF) remains controversial. Current guidelines recommend indefinite OAC based on stroke risk profiles, but long-term therapy adherence is suboptimal due to bleeding concerns. Recent randomized trials—ALONE-AF and OCEAN—provide critical insights into this debate. The ALONE-AF trial demonstrated that discontinuing OAC in patients without arrhythmia recurrence ≥1 year post-ablation (mean CHA₂DS₂-VASc score 2.1) significantly reduced major bleeding without increasing thromboembolic risk. However, the positive composite endpoint was predominantly driven by bleeding reduction, and the stroke comparison alone was underpowered. Similarly, the OCEAN trial showed no additional benefit of rivaroxaban over aspirin in stroke prevention among patients with successful ablation, while highlighting higher bleeding risks with anticoagulation. Importantly, the observed event rate in OCEAN was only ≈0.66 per 100 patient-years—far below the anticipated rate—yielding confidence intervals too wide to conclusively establish thromboembolic safety. These findings support individualized OAC management, particularly for patients with low-to-intermediate stroke risk (CHA₂DS₂-VASc 2–4) and no recurrence. Nevertheless, the persistently low event rates across trials, including OPTION (stroke rate ≈1.2–1.3% despite mean CHA₂DS₂-VASc of 3.5), suggest that post-ablation thromboembolic risk may have been overestimated, and traditional risk scores may no longer accurately stratify risk in this population. Emerging technologies like pulsed‑field ablation (PFA) may offer the potential to shorten OAC duration, but current evidence is derived almost entirely from thermal‑ablation cohorts and limited to small, underpowered PFA studies. Future studies should focus on high-risk subgroups and novel ablation strategies to refine personalized antithrombotic therapy.

AI.tldr: ALONE-AF和OCEAN试验提示，房颤消融成功后根据卒中风险个体化停用口服抗凝可减少出血而不增加血栓栓塞，但事件率低致统计效能不足。
AI.motivation: 房颤成功导管消融后口服抗凝的最佳时长尚存争议，指南基于卒中风险推荐无限期抗凝，但长期依从性因出血顾虑不佳，近期随机试验为这一争议提供新证据。
AI.method: 本文为综述，汇总ALONE-AF和OCEAN等近期随机试验，纳入房颤消融成功患者，比较停用或调整抗凝策略，主要终点为血栓栓塞和出血事件，统计方法为试验报告的事件率与置信区间分析。
AI.result: ALONE-AF显示无复发≥1年者停抗凝显著减少大出血且不增加血栓栓塞，但复合终点主要由出血驱动，卒中比较效能不足；OCEAN中利伐沙班较阿司匹林无额外卒中预防获益且出血更高，事件率仅约0.66/100患者年，置信区间过宽；OPTION试验卒中率约1.2-1.3%（平均CHA₂DS₂-VASc 3.5）。
AI.conclusion: 支持对低中危（CHA₂DS₂-VASc 2-4）且无复发患者个体化抗凝管理，传统风险评分可能高估消融后血栓风险；PFA缩短抗凝的证据有限，未来需聚焦高危亚组和新型消融策略。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）成功导管消融（CA）后口服抗凝（OAC）的最佳持续时间仍存在争议。当前指南基于卒中风险特征推荐无限期OAC，但由于出血顾虑，长期治疗依从性欠佳。近期随机试验——ALONE-AF和OCEAN——为这一争议提供了关键见解。ALONE-AF试验表明，在消融后≥1年无心律失常复发（平均CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分2.1）的患者中停用OAC可显著减少大出血，且不增加血栓栓塞风险。然而，阳性复合终点主要由出血减少驱动，单纯卒中比较的统计效能不足。同样，OCEAN试验显示，在成功消融的患者中，利伐沙班在卒中预防方面较阿司匹林无额外获益，同时强调抗凝治疗出血风险更高。重要的是，OCEAN中观察到的事件率仅为每100患者年约0.66例——远低于预期率——导致置信区间过宽，无法确证血栓栓塞安全性。这些发现支持个体化OAC管理，特别是对于卒中风险低至中等（CHA₂DS₂-VASc 2–4）且无复发的患者。然而，包括OPTION（尽管平均CHA₂DS₂-VASc为3.5，卒中率仍约1.2–1.3%）在内的各项试验中持续较低的事件率提示，消融后血栓栓塞风险可能被高估，传统风险评分可能不再能准确对该人群进行风险分层。脉冲场消融（PFA）等新兴技术可能具有缩短OAC持续时间的潜力，但当前证据几乎完全来自热消融队列，且限于小型、统计效能不足的PFA研究。未来研究应聚焦于高危亚组和新型消融策略，以完善个体化抗血栓治疗。

title: Multimodal AI-Integrated Digital Twin for Noninvasive Targeting of Post-Infarct Ventricular Tachycardia
Beyond the obvious in childhood obesity: exploring cardiac electrophysiological balance index and subclinical risk.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Childhood obesity is associated with adverse cardiovascular outcomes, including increased risk of arrhythmias and subclinical myocardial dysfunction. However, its impact on cardiac electrophysiological balance remains underexplored. The index of cardiac electrophysiological balance, calculated as QT/QRS ratio and corrected form of index of cardiac electrophysiological balance, emerged as novel electrocardiographic markers of ventricular arrhythmia risk. Although these parameters have been investigated in adult populations, data in obese children are lacking. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of obesity on index of cardiac electrophysiological balance and corrected form of index of cardiac electrophysiological balance in children and explore their associations with metabolic and anthropometric measures.

METHODS: This retrospective cross-sectional study included 50 obese, 23 healthy children aged 10-18 years. Demographic, metabolic, electrocardiographic, and echocardiographic data were retrieved from hospital records. Index of cardiac electrophysiological balance, corrected form of index of cardiac electrophysiological balance, and repolarisation indices (QTc dispersion, Tp-e dispersion, and P-wave dispersion) were manually measured from 12-lead electrocardiograms. Associations with metabolic and anthropometric parameters were analysed using linear regression.

RESULTS: Index of cardiac electrophysiological balance and corrected form of index of cardiac electrophysiological balance values were significantly lower in obese children than in controls (p < 0.001). QTc, Tp-e, and P-wave dispersions were also increased, indicating greater electrical heterogeneity. Index of cardiac electrophysiological balance showed negative correlations with LDL and total cholesterol levels. Tp-e duration and Tp-e/QTc ratio were inversely associated with hip circumference z-scores, possibly reflecting protective effects of gluteofemoral fat distribution.

CONCLUSION: Childhood obesity may disrupt cardiac electrophysiological balance and repolarisation, even in the absence of overt cardiovascular disease. Index of cardiac electrophysiological balance and corrected form of index of cardiac electrophysiological balance could serve as early markers of arrhythmia risk. Prospective studies are needed to validate their prognostic significance.

AI.tldr: 肥胖儿童较健康儿童iCEB及iCEBc显著降低，QTc、Tp-e及P波离散度增大，提示即使无显性心血管疾病也存在心室电生理平衡与复极异常。
AI.motivation: 儿童肥胖与心律失常及亚临床心肌功能障碍相关，但对其心脏电生理平衡的影响研究不足；iCEB（QT/QRS）及校正iCEBc是反映室性心律失常风险的新型心电图指标，已在成人中研究，肥胖儿童数据缺乏。本研究旨在评估肥胖对儿童iCEB及iCEBc的影响，并探讨其与代谢及人体测量指标的关系。
AI.method: 回顾性横断面研究，纳入10-18岁肥胖儿童50例与健康对照23例，从病历中提取人口学、代谢、心电图及超声心动图数据；手工测量12导联心电图获得iCEB、iCEBc及复极指标（QTc离散度、Tp-e离散度、P波离散度）；采用线性回归分析其与代谢及人体测量参数的关联。
AI.result: 肥胖儿童iCEB与iCEBc均显著低于对照组（p<0.001）；QTc、Tp-e及P波离散度升高，提示电异质性增加。iCEB与LDL及总胆固醇呈负相关；Tp-e时限及Tp-e/QTc比值与臀围z评分呈负相关，可能反映臀股部脂肪分布的保护作用。摘要未报告具体效应量及95%置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 儿童肥胖可能在无显性心血管疾病时即破坏心脏电生理平衡与复极，iCEB及iCEBc有望作为心律失常风险的早期标志物；但本研究为单中心小样本回顾性横断面设计，无法确立因果关系，其预后价值尚需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：儿童肥胖与不良心血管结局相关，包括心律失常风险增加和亚临床心肌功能障碍。然而，其对心脏电生理平衡的影响仍未得到充分探索。心脏电生理平衡指数（通过QT/QRS比值计算）及其校正形式已成为心室心律失常风险的新型心电图标志物。尽管这些参数已在成人人群中研究过，但肥胖儿童的数据尚缺乏。本研究旨在评估肥胖对儿童心脏电生理平衡指数及其校正形式的影响，并探讨其与代谢和人体测量指标的关系。

方法：这项回顾性横断面研究纳入了50名肥胖儿童和23名健康儿童，年龄10-18岁。从医院记录中获取人口学、代谢、心电图和超声心动图数据。心脏电生理平衡指数、心脏电生理平衡指数校正形式及复极指标（QTc离散度、Tp-e离散度、P波离散度）通过12导联心电图手动测量。使用线性回归分析与代谢和人体测量参数的关联。

结果：肥胖儿童的心脏电生理平衡指数和心脏电生理平衡指数校正形式值显著低于对照组（p < 0.001）。QTc、Tp-e和P波离散度也增加，表明电异质性增大。心脏电生理平衡指数与LDL和总胆固醇水平呈负相关。Tp-e持续时间及Tp-e/QTc比值与臀围z评分呈负相关，可能反映臀股脂肪分布的保护效应。

结论：儿童肥胖可能破坏心脏电生理平衡和复极，即使在无明显心血管疾病的情况下。心脏电生理平衡指数及其校正形式可作为心律失常风险的早期标志物。需要前瞻性研究来验证其预后意义。

title: Homozygous TNNC1-A8V Causes Impaired Diastolic Function and Restrictive Cardiomyopathy in Children and Mice.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pathological variants in TNNC1 are associated with the development of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Unlike other sarcomeric genes, TNNC1 variants tend to cause early-onset disease, and the most common variant identified in the gene, TNNC1-A8V, may also lead to severe diastolic dysfunction and restrictive cardiomyopathy. Yet, this variant-disease association, and the mechanism of diastolic disease development remain poorly understood. To address this, we sought to determine whether the A8V variant was associated with the development of restrictive cardiomyopathy, and if so, to determine the frequency and age-specific spectrum of disease relative to hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

METHODS: A pediatric proband was identified carrying the TNNC1-A8V variant. Sanger sequencing and cardiac evaluations were performed on several of the proband's family members. A literature search was performed to evaluate the cardiac penetrance of TNNC1-A8V. Additionally, we investigated cardiac contractility in a homozygous A8V mouse model. We assessed left ventricular function in 10- to 12-week-old mice via cardiac catheterization and left ventricular global and segmental myocardial strain analyses. Electrophysiological studies were conducted to evaluate arrhythmic predisposition.

RESULTS: We report an 8-month-old female homozygous for p.A8V (c.C23T) who presented with bi-atrial enlargement, normal ventricular function, and ventricular tachycardia. Cardiac histology of the proband showed subendocardial vacuolization, endocardial fibrosis, and localized myocardial enhancement. The A8V mouse model showed an elevated end-diastolic pressure-volume relationship, prolonged relaxation time (tau), and impaired ventricular relaxation rate (dP/dt min) compared with controls, consistent with increased myocardial stiffness. Strain analyses further highlighted left ventricular dysfunction and dyssynchrony, and ECG analyses revealed atrial remodeling and enlargement at 10 weeks of age.

CONCLUSIONS: Homozygous A8V mice recapitulate the severe diastolic dysfunction and early-onset restrictive cardiomyopathy observed in the pediatric proband carrying this pathogenic variant, underscoring the utility of this model for advancing translational research. Identifying myofilament-specific defects opens the door for precision therapies tailored to the underlying molecular disarray.

AI.tldr: TNNC1-A8V纯合变异可致儿童早发限制型心肌病，小鼠模型重现严重舒张功能障碍与心室不同步，为精准治疗提供依据。
AI.motivation: TNNC1变异与其他肌节基因不同，倾向于导致早发疾病，最常见变异A8V可能引起严重舒张功能障碍和限制型心肌病，但该变异与疾病的关联及舒张功能障碍的发生机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在明确A8V是否与限制型心肌病相关，并确定其相对肥厚型心肌病的发生频率和年龄相关疾病谱。
AI.method: 研究纳入1例携带TNNC1-A8V变异的儿科先证者，对其多名家属进行Sanger测序和心脏评估，并通过文献检索评估A8V的心脏外显率。同时建立纯合A8V小鼠模型，在10-12周龄时通过心导管检查及左心室整体和节段心肌应变分析评估左心室功能，并行电生理检查评估心律失常易感性。
AI.result: 先证者为8月龄女性A8V纯合子（c.C23T），表现为双心房扩大、心室功能正常和室性心动过速；心肌组织学显示心内膜下空泡化、心内膜纤维化及局限性心肌强化。与对照相比，A8V小鼠舒张末期压力-容积关系升高、松弛时间常数（tau）延长、心室松弛速率（dP/dt min）受损，提示心肌僵硬度增加；应变分析显示左心室功能障碍和不同步，10周龄心电图显示心房重构和扩大。摘要未报告文献检索的外显率数据及组间比较的P值。
AI.conclusion: 纯合A8V小鼠重现了儿科先证者的严重舒张功能障碍和早发限制型心肌病，支持该模型用于转化研究。识别肌丝特异性缺陷为针对分子紊乱的精准治疗提供了可能；但当前证据主要来自单例先证者和小鼠模型，人群外显率及年龄相关疾病谱仍需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景：TNNC1的致病性变异与肥厚型心肌病的发生相关。与其他肌节基因不同，TNNC1变异往往导致早发型疾病，该基因中最常见的变异TNNC1-A8V也可能导致严重的舒张功能障碍和限制型心肌病。然而，这种变异与疾病的关联以及舒张性疾病发生的机制仍知之甚少。为此，我们试图确定A8V变异是否与限制型心肌病的发生相关，如果相关，则确定相对于肥厚型心肌病的疾病频率和年龄特异性谱。

方法：鉴定出一名携带TNNC1-A8V变异的儿科先证者。对先证者的几名家庭成员进行了Sanger测序和心脏评估。进行文献检索以评估TNNC1-A8V的心脏外显率。此外，我们在纯合A8V小鼠模型中研究了心脏收缩力。我们通过心导管检查和左心室整体及节段心肌应变分析评估了10至12周龄小鼠的左心室功能。进行电生理研究以评估心律失常易感性。

结果：我们报告一名8个月大的女性纯合子p.A8V (c.C23T)，表现为双心房扩大、心室功能正常和室性心动过速。先证者的心脏组织学显示心内膜下空泡化、心内膜纤维化和局部心肌强化。与对照组相比，A8V小鼠模型显示舒张末期压力-容积关系升高、松弛时间(tau)延长和心室松弛速率(dP/dt min)受损，与心肌僵硬度增加一致。应变分析进一步突出了左心室功能障碍和不同步，心电图分析显示10周龄时心房重构和扩大。

结论：纯合A8V小鼠重现了携带该致病性变异的儿科先证者中观察到的严重舒张功能障碍和早发型限制型心肌病，强调了该模型在推进转化研究中的实用性。识别肌丝特异性缺陷为针对潜在分子紊乱的精准治疗打开了大门。

title: Fragmented QRS: Electrophysiological Bases, Pathophysiological Mechanisms, and Clinical Prognostic Significance
summary: Background: Fragmented QRS (fQRS) is characterized by morphological irregularities in ventricular depolarization on a standard 12-lead surface electrocardiogram (ECG) and is considered a non-invasive indicator of myocardial conduction heterogeneity. Microstructural changes such as non-uniform anisotropy, gap junction reorganization, and interstitial fibrosis can disrupt the propagation of the electrical impulse, leading to notching in the QRS complex.Methods: This study is designed as a narrative review to evaluate the electrophysiological basis and clinical implications of fQRS. A literature search was conducted in the PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science databases to include peer-reviewed articles published between 2006 and 2025 that addressed fQRS, myocardial scarring, and ventricular arrhythmias (VA).Results: Current data indicate that the presence of a fQRS shows a strong correlation with myocardial scarring, particularly in ischemic cardiomyopathies, and may serve as an independent risk marker for VA and cardiac mortality. Additionally, it has been reported that in heart failure (HF) and certain channelopathies, fQRS carries prognostic value as a superficial reflection of electrical remodeling. However, the fact that evaluation methods are largely visual and qualitative, along with interobserver variability and dependence on ECG filter settings, limits the clinical utility of this finding.Conclusion: Fragmented QRS has the potential to provide important prognostic information as an electrocardiographic indicator of myocardial fibrosis and conduction heterogeneity. However, standardized definition criteria, quantitative analysis methods, and large-scale prospective studies are required for its integration into routine clinical practice.
journal: Cukurova Anestezi ve Cerrahi Bilimler Dergisi

AI.tldr: 碎裂QRS波与心肌瘢痕（尤其缺血性心肌病）强相关，可作为室性心律失常和心源性死亡的独立风险标志，但评估方法主观且缺乏标准化。
AI.motivation: 碎裂QRS波（fQRS）是标准12导联心电图上心室除极的形态学异常，被视为心肌传导异质性的无创指标。既往证据提示其与心肌瘢痕和室性心律失常相关，但电生理基础、病理生理机制及临床预后价值尚需系统梳理，尤其缺乏标准化定义和定量分析方法。
AI.method: 本研究为叙述性综述，检索PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science数据库中2006年至2025年发表的同行评议文献，纳入涉及fQRS、心肌瘢痕和室性心律失常（VA）的研究，评估fQRS的电生理基础和临床意义。
AI.result: 现有数据表明，fQRS的存在与心肌瘢痕（尤其缺血性心肌病）强相关，可能作为VA和心源性死亡的独立风险标志。在心力衰竭和某些离子通道病中，fQRS作为电重构的表面反映具有预后价值。然而，评估方法主要为视觉和定性，存在观察者间变异性和对心电图滤波设置的依赖，限制了其临床实用性。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: fQRS作为心肌纤维化和传导异质性的心电图指标，具有提供重要预后信息的潜力。但其整合到常规临床实践仍需标准化定义标准、定量分析方法和大规模前瞻性研究。对电生理实践的影响在于提示fQRS可作为风险分层工具，但当前局限性要求谨慎解读。

summary_zh: 背景：碎裂QRS波（fQRS）的特征是标准12导联体表心电图（ECG）上心室除极的形态学不规则，被认为是心肌传导异质性的无创指标。非均匀各向异性、缝隙连接重组和间质纤维化等微结构变化可破坏电冲动的传播，导致QRS波群出现切迹。方法：本研究设计为叙述性综述，旨在评估fQRS的电生理基础和临床意义。在PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science数据库中进行了文献检索，纳入2006年至2025年间发表的、涉及fQRS、心肌瘢痕和室性心律失常（VA）的同行评议文章。结果：当前数据表明，fQRS的存在与心肌瘢痕（尤其是缺血性心肌病）呈强相关，并可能作为VA和心源性死亡的独立风险标志物。此外，有报道称在心力衰竭（HF）和某些通道病中，fQRS作为电重构的浅表反映具有预后价值。然而，评估方法在很大程度上是视觉和定性的，加之观察者间变异性和对ECG滤波器设置的依赖性，限制了该发现的临床应用。结论：碎裂QRS波作为心肌纤维化和传导异质性的心电图指标，有潜力提供重要的预后信息。然而，要将其整合到常规临床实践中，需要标准化的定义标准、定量分析方法和大规模前瞻性研究。

title: Cardiac Sarcoidosis: A Practical Guide for Cardiologists.
summary:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Cardiac sarcoidosis (CS) is an inflammatory granulomatous cardiomyopathy associated with atrioventricular block, ventricular arrhythmias, heart failure (HF), and sudden cardiac death (SCD). Diagnosis and management remain challenging because myocardial involvement is patchy and evidence from randomized trials is limited. This review summarizes current knowledge on CS, focusing on advances in diagnosis, immunosuppression, and prevention of arrhythmic events.

RECENT FINDINGS: Cardiac involvement is clinically recognized in 5-10% of patients with sarcoidosis but is more frequent in imaging and autopsy studies. Cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) and ^18F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET) provide complementary information on myocardial scar and active inflammation. Multimodality imaging, extracardiac tissue diagnosis, guided endomyocardial biopsy, and consensus criteria improve diagnostic confidence. Corticosteroids remain first-line therapy for active inflammation, while steroid-sparing agents are increasingly used to reduce corticosteroid exposure or treat persistent disease. Inflammasome/interleukin-1 inhibition is an emerging targeted strategy, but its clinical efficacy remains unproven. SCD risk stratification now extends beyond left ventricular ejection fraction to include ventricular arrhythmias, conduction disease, ventricular dysfunction, and myocardial scar burden. Implantable cardioverter-defibrillator therapy remains central in selected high-risk patients. CS requires early recognition of both inflammation and myocardial scar. CMR and FDG-PET are central to diagnosis, prognosis, and therapeutic decisions, while management combines immunosuppression, HF therapy, and arrhythmia prevention. Major uncertainties remain regarding optimal diagnostic criteria, immunosuppression strategies, serial imaging, and primary-prevention ICD selection. Prospective studies and randomized trials are needed to refine treatment and risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 心脏结节病诊断依赖CMR与FDG-PET互补评估炎症与瘢痕，治疗以激素为主，ICD用于高危患者，但诊断标准与免疫抑制策略仍缺乏随机试验证据。
AI.motivation: 心脏结节病是伴房室传导阻滞、室性心律失常、心衰和心源性猝死的炎症性肉芽肿性心肌病，因心肌受累呈斑片状且随机试验证据有限，诊断与治疗始终困难，本文旨在梳理诊断、免疫抑制和心律失常事件预防方面的进展。
AI.method: 综述性文章，非原始研究，无样本量与干预分组。文章总结心脏结节病的诊断进展（CMR与FDG-PET多模态影像、心外组织活检、指导性心内膜心肌活检、共识标准）、免疫抑制治疗（糖皮质激素一线、保激素药物、炎症小体/IL-1抑制）及心律失常事件预防（SCD风险分层与ICD）。摘要未报告具体终点定义与统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体数值、效应量、95%置信区间或P值。定性要点：心脏受累在结节病患者中临床识别率为5-10%，影像与尸检研究中更常见；CMR与FDG-PET分别提供心肌瘢痕与活动性炎症的互补信息；激素仍为活动性炎症一线治疗，保激素药物使用增加；炎症小体/IL-1抑制为新兴靶向策略但临床疗效未获证实；SCD风险分层已从LVEF扩展至室性心律失常、传导疾病、心室功能障碍与心肌瘢痕负荷。
AI.conclusion: 心脏结节病需早期识别炎症与心肌瘢痕，CMR与FDG-PET是诊断、预后与治疗决策的核心，管理需联合免疫抑制、心衰治疗与心律失常预防，ICD在部分高危患者中仍居中心地位。最佳诊断标准、免疫抑制策略、系列影像随访及一级预防ICD选择仍存重大不确定性，需前瞻性研究与随机试验加以完善；本文为综述，结论受限于缺乏随机对照证据。

summary_zh:
目的综述：心脏结节病（CS）是一种炎症性肉芽肿性心肌病，与房室传导阻滞、室性心律失常、心力衰竭（HF）和心源性猝死（SCD）相关。诊断和管理仍然具有挑战性，因为心肌受累呈斑片状，且随机试验的证据有限。本综述总结了关于CS的当前知识，重点关注诊断、免疫抑制和心律失常事件预防方面的进展。

近期发现：在5-10%的结节病患者中，心脏受累被临床识别，但在影像学和尸检研究中更为常见。心脏磁共振（CMR）和^18F-氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描（FDG-PET）提供关于心肌瘢痕和活动性炎症的互补信息。多模态成像、心外组织诊断、引导性心内膜心肌活检和共识标准提高了诊断信心。皮质类固醇仍是活动性炎症的一线治疗，而保类固醇药物越来越多地用于减少皮质类固醇暴露或治疗持续性疾病。炎症小体/白细胞介素-1抑制是一种新兴的靶向策略，但其临床疗效尚未得到证实。SCD风险分层现已超越左心室射血分数，包括室性心律失常、传导疾病、心室功能障碍和心肌瘢痕负荷。植入式心律转复除颤器治疗在选定的高风险患者中仍处于核心地位。CS需要早期识别炎症和心肌瘢痕。CMR和FDG-PET在诊断、预后和治疗决策中处于核心地位，而管理结合了免疫抑制、HF治疗和心律失常预防。在最佳诊断标准、免疫抑制策略、系列成像和一级预防ICD选择方面仍存在重大不确定性。需要前瞻性研究和随机试验来完善治疗和风险分层。

title: Small but lethal: cystic tumour of the atrioventricular node-a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Cystic tumours of the AV node (CTAVN) are exceptionally uncommon congenital cardiac tuours, with an incidence of 0.0017-0.03%.

CASE SUMMARY: A 47-year-old woman with recurrent symptomatic tachycardia underwent an ablation. Coronary sinus was noted to be enlarged. Subsequent cardiac CT revelead a well-circumscribed cystic lesioni in the Triangle of Koch, suspicious of a CTAVN. Multimodal imaging, including echocardiography, coronary angiography and cardiac MRI confirmed a non-vascular, encapsulated lesion with imaging characteristics consistent with a benign cystic mass. Given the risk of sudden cardiac death, surgical resection was performed. Histopathology confirmed CTAVN. The postoperative course as complicated by complete heart block requiring pacemaker implantation, with no recurrence at one year.

DISCUSSION: CTAVN is a rare but clinically significant benign tumour associated with conduction abnormalities and malignant arrhythmias. This care highlights the importance of multimodal imaging in diagnosis and the role of early surgical intervention to mitigate life-threatening complications.

AI.tldr: 47岁女性反复心悸，消融前影像发现Koch三角区囊性占位，手术切除确诊房室结囊性肿瘤，术后完全性房室传导阻滞需起搏器，1年无复发。
AI.motivation: 房室结囊性肿瘤（CTAVN）是极罕见的先天性心脏肿瘤，发病率0.0017%-0.03%，可导致传导异常和恶性心律失常，甚至猝死；既往证据多为个案，诊断和干预策略尚不明确。
AI.method: 病例报告。47岁女性，反复症状性心动过速，拟行消融；冠状静脉窦扩大，心脏CT发现Koch三角区边界清楚的囊性病变，疑诊CTAVN；多模态影像（超声心动图、冠状动脉造影、心脏MRI）证实为非血管性、包裹性囊性肿块，符合良性囊性病变。因猝死风险行手术切除，组织病理确诊CTAVN。终点为术后并发症和复发。
AI.result: 手术切除后病理确诊CTAVN。术后病程并发完全性房室传导阻滞，需植入起搏器；随访1年无复发。摘要未报告其他定量数据。
AI.conclusion: CTAVN虽罕见但临床意义重大，多模态影像对诊断至关重要，早期手术切除可降低致命性并发症风险；但术后完全性房室传导阻滞需起搏器提示手术风险，需权衡获益与传导系统损伤。

summary_zh:
背景：房室结囊性肿瘤（CTAVN）是一种极为罕见的先天性心脏肿瘤，发病率为0.0017-0.03%。

病例摘要：一名47岁女性，因反复发作的症状性心动过速接受了消融术。术中注意到冠状静脉窦扩大。随后的心脏CT显示Koch三角区有一个边界清晰的囊性病变，疑似CTAVN。包括超声心动图、冠状动脉造影和心脏MRI在内的多模态影像学检查证实了一个无血管、包裹性的病变，其影像学特征与良性囊性肿块一致。鉴于存在心源性猝死的风险，进行了手术切除。组织病理学证实为CTAVN。术后病程因完全性心脏传导阻滞而复杂化，需要植入起搏器，一年内无复发。

讨论：CTAVN是一种罕见但具有临床意义的良性肿瘤，与传导异常和恶性心律失常相关。本病例强调了多模态影像学在诊断中的重要性，以及早期手术干预在减轻危及生命的并发症方面的作用。

title: Case Report: Iatrogenic left main coronary artery dissection during premature ventricular contraction ablation managed with emergent coronary artery bypass grafting.
summary: Premature ventricular contraction (PVC) ablation via retrograde aortic access is generally safe, but iatrogenic left main coronary artery (LMCA) dissection is a rare and potentially catastrophic complication. This case adds to the literature by describing LMCA dissection during PVC ablation managed with primary emergent coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) rather than percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), guided by intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) and Heart Team decision-making. A 60-year-old man with symptomatic, medication-refractory monomorphic PVCs (17.4% burden with nonsustained ventricular tachycardia) and preserved left ventricular function underwent elective PVC ablation via retrograde aortic access. Shortly after successful ablation at the aortomitral continuity, he developed sudden excruciating chest pain and anterior ST-segment elevation with hemodynamic instability. Emergent coronary angiography suggested LMCA dissection with occlusion of the proximal left anterior descending (LAD) artery and near-occlusive involvement of the proximal ramus intermedius. Balloon angioplasty restored limited flow, and intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) demonstrated an ostial LMCA dissection extending into both branches with true lumen compression and a heavily calcified proximal LAD segment, making complex LMCA bifurcation stenting high risk. After rapid Heart Team consultation, the patient underwent emergent CABG with left internal mammary artery (LIMA)-LAD and saphenous vein grafts to the ramus intermedius branch of the LMCA, along with intra-aortic balloon pump support. He was extubated and weaned off mechanical support on postoperative day 1 and discharged home on day 8; follow-up at 3 months revealed reduced ejection fraction (25%-30%) managed by advanced heart failure services. This case highlights mechanical LMCA ostial injury as a rare complication of retrograde PVC ablation and highlights the importance of immediate recognition of ST-segment elevation, emergent coronary angiography, and early involvement of a multidisciplinary Heart Team. IVUS is crucial to define dissection extent. When ostial or bifurcation LMCA dissection occurs in the setting of hemodynamic compromise and calcified, stent-unfavorable anatomy, guideline-directed emergent CABG can provide definitive and potentially life-saving revascularization.

AI.tldr: 60岁男性经逆行主动脉途径行室早消融后并发医源性左主干夹层，经IVUS评估和心脏团队决策后行急诊CABG，术后恢复良好但3个月随访LVEF降至25%-30%。
AI.motivation: 经逆行主动脉途径行室早消融总体安全，但医源性左主干夹层是罕见且可能致命的并发症。既往文献多采用PCI处理，而本例采用急诊CABG，为临床决策提供新参考。
AI.method: 病例报告。患者为60岁男性，症状性、药物难治性单形性室早（负荷17.4%，伴非持续性室速），左室功能保留，择期经逆行主动脉途径行室早消融。终点为并发症识别、处理及随访结果。
AI.result: 在主动脉-二尖瓣连续区成功消融后，患者突发剧烈胸痛、前壁ST段抬高和血流动力学不稳定。急诊冠脉造影提示左主干夹层，前降支近段闭塞，中间支近段近闭塞。球囊扩张恢复有限血流，IVUS显示左主干开口夹层累及双分支、真腔受压，且前降支近段严重钙化，复杂分叉支架置入风险高。经心脏团队会诊后行急诊CABG（LIMA-LAD及大隐静脉至中间支），并置入主动脉内球囊反搏。术后第1天拔管并脱离机械支持，第8天出院；3个月随访LVEF降至25%-30%，由晚期心衰团队管理。
AI.conclusion: 经逆行主动脉途径行室早消融时，机械性左主干开口损伤是罕见并发症。立即识别ST段抬高、急诊冠脉造影和早期多学科心脏团队参与至关重要。IVUS有助于明确夹层范围。当开口或分叉部左主干夹层伴血流动力学不稳定且钙化、支架不友好时，指南导向的急诊CABG可提供确定且可能救命的血运重建。

summary_zh:
背景：经逆行主动脉途径行室性早搏（PVC）消融通常是安全的，但医源性左主干冠状动脉（LMCA）夹层是一种罕见且可能灾难性的并发症。本病例通过描述在PVC消融过程中发生LMCA夹层、并在血管内超声（IVUS）引导和心脏团队决策下采用直接急诊冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）而非经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）进行管理，为文献增添了资料。

方法：一名60岁男性，患有症状性、药物难治性单形性PVC（负荷17.4%，伴非持续性室性心动过速）且左心室功能保留，接受了经逆行主动脉途径的择期PVC消融。在主动脉-二尖瓣连续处成功消融后不久，他出现突发剧烈胸痛和前壁ST段抬高，伴血流动力学不稳定。急诊冠状动脉造影提示LMCA夹层，左前降支（LAD）近段闭塞，并近闭塞性累及中间支近段。球囊血管成形术恢复了有限血流，血管内超声（IVUS）显示LMCA开口处夹层延伸至两个分支，伴真腔受压和LAD近段严重钙化，使得复杂的LMCA分叉部支架置入风险很高。经过快速心脏团队会诊，患者接受了急诊CABG，使用左乳内动脉（LIMA）-LAD和大隐静脉移植至LMCA的中间支，并辅以主动脉内球囊反搏支持。

结果：他在术后第1天拔管并脱离机械支持，第8天出院回家；3个月随访显示射血分数降低（25%-30%），由晚期心力衰竭服务管理。

结论：本病例强调机械性LMCA开口损伤是逆行PVC消融的罕见并发症，并强调立即识别ST段抬高、急诊冠状动脉造影和早期多学科心脏团队参与的重要性。IVUS对于确定夹层范围至关重要。当在血流动力学受损和钙化、不利于支架的解剖情况下发生开口或分叉部LMCA夹层时，指南指导的急诊CABG可以提供决定性的、可能挽救生命的血运重建。

title: Predictive Value of the Electrical Risk Score for Ventricular Arrhythmias in Heart Failure Patients with Primary Prevention Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillators
summary: Background: Implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs) are essential for the primary prevention of sudden cardiac death in heart failure (HF); however, appropriate shocks increase mortality and impair quality of life. The electrical risk score (ERS) is an electrocardiographic (ECG)-based composite index with proven prognostic value, but its ability to predict ventricular arrhythmias in HF remains unclear. This study aims to evaluate the predictive value of the ERS for ventricular arrhythmia-related ICD shocks in HF patients undergoing primary prevention ICD implantation. Methods: In this study, 91 patients with HF were followed for 12 months after ICD implantation. The ERS was calculated from baseline ECGs. Patients were grouped based on ERS (<3 vs. ≥3), according to receiver operating characteristic curve analysis. Multivariate logistic regression was used to evaluate predictors of appropriate ICD shocks, and predictive performance was compared using the DeLong test. Results: Thirty-five patients (38.5%) experienced at least one appropriate ICD shock. The median ERS was significantly higher in the shock group compared to the non-shock group (p < 0.001). Patients with ERS ≥ 3 had significantly higher rates of the anti-tachycardia pacing therapy (p < 0.001) and HF-related hospitalization (p = 0.004). ERS was an independent predictor of ICD shocks (p < 0.001), with superior discriminative performance (AUC 0.882) compared to most ECG markers, including frontal QRS T angle, QRS duration, Tp-e interval, and heart rate. Conclusions: The ERS was associated with ventricular arrhythmia-related ICD shocks in HF patients undergoing primary prevention ICD implantation. The ERS may identify patients at increased arrhythmic risk and guides follow-up and ICD management.

AI.tldr: 在91例心衰一级预防ICD患者中，基线电风险评分（ERS）≥3分与12个月内恰当ICD电击独立相关，AUC达0.882，优于多数传统心电图指标。
AI.motivation: ICD是心衰患者预防心脏性猝死的重要手段，但恰当电击增加死亡风险并损害生活质量。电风险评分（ERS）是基于心电图的复合指标，其预后价值已获证实，但其对心衰一级预防ICD患者室性心律失常的预测能力尚不明确。
AI.method: 单中心前瞻性队列研究，纳入91例接受一级预防ICD植入的心衰患者，随访12个月。基于基线心电图计算ERS，根据ROC曲线分析以ERS 3分为界分为两组（<3 vs. ≥3）。主要终点为恰当ICD电击，采用多变量logistic回归评估预测因素，DeLong检验比较预测性能。
AI.result: 35例（38.5%）患者发生至少一次恰当ICD电击。电击组ERS中位数显著高于非电击组（p<0.001）。ERS≥3组抗心动过速起搏治疗率（p<0.001）及心衰相关住院率（p=0.004）显著更高。ERS是ICD电击的独立预测因素（p<0.001），其判别性能（AUC 0.882）优于多数心电图指标，包括额面QRS-T夹角、QRS时限、Tp-e间期及心率。
AI.conclusion: 在行一级预防ICD植入的心衰患者中，ERS与室性心律失常相关ICD电击独立相关，可识别心律失常高风险患者，辅助随访和ICD管理决策。但本研究样本量较小、单中心、随访仅12个月，ERS的临床推广价值仍需更大规模前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh: 背景：植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）对于心力衰竭（HF）患者心脏性猝死的一级预防至关重要；然而，适当的电击会增加死亡率并损害生活质量。电风险评分（ERS）是一种基于心电图（ECG）的复合指标，具有已证实的预后价值，但其预测HF患者室性心律失常的能力仍不清楚。本研究旨在评估ERS对接受一级预防ICD植入的HF患者中室性心律失常相关ICD电击的预测价值。方法：在本研究中，91例HF患者在ICD植入后随访12个月。ERS根据基线ECG计算。根据受试者工作特征曲线分析，患者按ERS（<3 vs. ≥3）分组。采用多因素logistic回归评估适当ICD电击的预测因素，并使用DeLong检验比较预测性能。结果：35例患者（38.5%）经历了至少一次适当的ICD电击。电击组的中位ERS显著高于非电击组（p < 0.001）。ERS ≥ 3的患者抗心动过速起搏治疗（p < 0.001）和HF相关住院（p = 0.004）的发生率显著更高。ERS是ICD电击的独立预测因素（p < 0.001），与大多数ECG标志物（包括额面QRS-T角度、QRS时限、Tp-e间期和心率）相比，具有更优的判别性能（AUC 0.882）。结论：ERS与接受一级预防ICD植入的HF患者中室性心律失常相关ICD电击相关。ERS可能识别心律失常风险增加的患者，并指导随访和ICD管理。

title: Analysis of Nonlinear Characteristics of Heart Rate for Predicting Sudden Cardiac Death
Fatal Refractory Hypokalemic Paralysis Secondary to Occupational Toluene Exposure: A Case Report
summary: Background Hypokalemic paralysis is a life-threatening emergency requiring rapid etiological identification. Distal renal tubular acidosis (dRTA) induced by chronic toluene exposure is a rare and underrecognized cause, most commonly reported in the context of recreational solvent inhalation. Fatal outcomes secondary to occupational exposure remain exceptionally uncommon in the published literature. Case Presentation We report a 42-year-old male carpenter with long-standing occupational exposure to organic solvents who presented with acute progressive flaccid quadriparesis. Laboratory evaluation revealed severe hypokalemia (1.0 mmol/L), hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis with a normal anion gap, hypomagnesemia, and preserved renal function. Urinalysis demonstrated inappropriate renal potassium wasting with a urine pH of 5,paradoxically elevated despite systemic acidemia (arterial pH 7.31),consistent with impaired distal tubular acidification. Electrocardiography showed typical hypokalemic changes including flattened T waves and prominent U waves. Guillain–Barré syndrome was excluded on the basis of normal cerebrospinal fluid analysis and non-demyelinating electroneuromyography. Despite aggressive intravenous potassium and magnesium replacement, hypokalemia remained refractory. The patient developed progressive respiratory muscle involvement and died on day 5 from refractory malignant ventricular arrhythmias. Conclusion This case highlights toluene-induced dRTA as a rare but potentially fatal cause of hypokalemic paralysis, even in occupational settings without deliberate solvent inhalation. The characteristic biochemical triad, normal anion gap metabolic acidosis, renal potassium wasting, and paradoxically alkaline urine, should prompt early consideration of this diagnosis. Clinicians must maintain a high index of suspicion in patients with relevant occupational exposure, as refractory hypokalemia carries a significant risk of fatal cardiac arrhythmias.

AI.tldr: 一例42岁木工因职业性甲苯暴露导致远端肾小管酸中毒，引发难治性低钾性瘫痪，最终死于恶性室性心律失常。
AI.motivation: 低钾性瘫痪是危及生命的急症，需快速病因鉴别。慢性甲苯暴露所致远端肾小管酸中毒（dRTA）是罕见且易被忽视的病因，既往多见于娱乐性溶剂吸入，职业性暴露致死的报道极少。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为42岁男性木工，长期职业性接触有机溶剂，因急性进行性弛缓性四肢瘫痪就诊。实验室检查显示严重低钾血症（1.0 mmol/L）、高氯性正常阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒、低镁血症、肾功能正常。尿检示不适当肾性失钾，尿pH 5（动脉pH 7.31时反常升高），提示远端小管酸化障碍。心电图示低钾改变（T波平坦、U波突出）。排除吉兰-巴雷综合征。
AI.result: 尽管积极静脉补钾补镁，低钾血症仍难治，患者出现进行性呼吸肌受累，第5天死于难治性恶性室性心律失常。摘要未报告其他定量统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 甲苯诱导的dRTA是低钾性瘫痪的罕见但潜在致死性病因，即使职业性暴露无故意吸入也可发生。正常阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒、肾性失钾和反常碱性尿三联征应提示早期考虑该诊断。临床医生对相关职业暴露患者应高度警惕，难治性低钾血症有致命性心律失常风险。

summary_zh: 背景：低钾性麻痹是一种危及生命的急症，需要快速明确病因。慢性甲苯暴露所致的远端肾小管酸中毒（dRTA）是一种罕见且未被充分认识的原因，最常见于娱乐性溶剂吸入的背景下。职业暴露继发的致死性结局在已发表文献中仍极为罕见。病例介绍：我们报告一名42岁男性木匠，长期职业性接触有机溶剂，表现为急性进行性弛缓性四肢瘫痪。实验室评估显示严重低钾血症（1.0 mmol/L）、高氯性代谢性酸中毒伴阴离子间隙正常、低镁血症，肾功能保留。尿液分析显示不适当的肾脏失钾，尿pH为5，尽管存在全身性酸血症（动脉pH 7.31）却矛盾性升高，符合远端肾小管酸化功能受损。心电图显示典型的低钾性改变，包括T波低平和显著U波。基于脑脊液分析正常和神经肌电图无脱髓鞘表现，排除了吉兰-巴雷综合征。尽管积极静脉补钾和补镁，低钾血症仍难以纠正。患者出现进行性呼吸肌受累，并于第5天死于难治性恶性室性心律失常。结论：本病例强调甲苯诱导的dRTA是低钾性麻痹的一种罕见但可能致命的原因，即使在无故意溶剂吸入的职业环境中也是如此。特征性的生化三联征——阴离子间隙正常的代谢性酸中毒、肾脏失钾和矛盾性碱性尿——应促使早期考虑该诊断。临床医生必须对具有相关职业暴露的患者保持高度怀疑，因为难治性低钾血症具有致命性心律失常的显著风险。

title: Asymptomatic High-Grade Atrioventricular Block in a Serviceman: A Case Report
summary: Background. High-grade atrioventricular (AV) conduction disorders are associated with an increased risk of syncope, severe hemodynamic compromise, and sudden cardiac death. Although these disorders usually manifest with clinically significant symptoms, some patients may remain asymptomatic despite advanced conduction abnormalities, making timely diagnosis and appropriate treatment particularly challenging. Such cases are of special clinical importance in individuals whose professional activities require a high level of physical fitness and constant readiness, including military personnel.Aim. To present a clinical case of asymptomatic severe bradyarrhythmia with transient high-grade atrioventricular block in a serviceman, to describe the diagnostic approach, and to demonstrate the effectiveness of permanent dual-chamber pacemaker implantation.Case Report. A serviceman underwent a routine medical examination without any cardiovascular complaints, including syncope, dizziness, dyspnea, or palpitations. Standard electrocardiography revealed severe bradycardia and second-degree AV block (Mobitz II) with 2:1 conduction. Twenty-four-hour Holter ECG monitoring demonstrated marked sinus bradycardia with an average heart rate of 40 beats/min, a minimum heart rate of 19 beats/min, numerous episodes of first- and second-degree AV block, recurrent episodes of high-grade AV block with 3:1 conduction, transient complete third-degree AV block, and RR pauses exceeding 3.4 seconds. More than 12.000 pauses longer than two seconds were recorded, predominantly during the nighttime. Echocardiography showed mildly reduced left ventricular systolic function with an ejection fraction of 49 %. Based on current clinical recommendations and the documented advanced conduction abnormalities, the patient underwent successful implantation of a dual-chamber rate-responsive pacemaker.Results. The patient underwent successful implantation of a dual-chamber rate-responsive pacemaker. Follow-up Holter ECG monitoring demonstrated stable cardiac rhythm with effective pacing, no clinically significant arrhythmias, and no pauses exceeding two seconds. The patient remained clinically stable during the postoperative period.Conclusions. This case highlights that severe atrioventricular conduction disorders may remain clinically silent despite pronounced electrophysiological abnormalities. Routine electrocardiographic screening followed by comprehensive Holter ECG monitoring plays a crucial role in detecting occult high-grade AV block and identifying patients at risk of potentially life-threatening complications. Timely implantation of a permanent dual-chamber pacemaker provides effective rhythm stabilization and represents the treatment of choice in patients with advanced AV conduction disturbances, even in the absence of clinical symptoms.

AI.tldr: 一名无症状军人常规体检发现严重心动过缓及高级别房室传导阻滞，植入双腔频率应答起搏器后心律稳定，提示无症状高级别AVB也可致严重风险。
AI.motivation: 高级别房室传导阻滞可导致晕厥、严重血流动力学障碍及心脏性猝死，但部分患者尽管存在晚期传导异常却完全无症状，导致及时诊断和治疗困难。对于需保持高体能和随时待命状态的人群（如军人），此类无症状病例的识别尤为重要。
AI.method: 病例报告。一名无心血管主诉的军人接受常规体检，通过标准心电图、24小时动态心电图和超声心动图进行评估。心电图显示严重心动过缓及二度房室传导阻滞（Mobitz II型，2:1传导）；动态心电图记录到平均心率40次/分、最低19次/分、多次一至二度房室传导阻滞、反复高级别房室传导阻滞（3:1传导）、短暂完全性三度房室传导阻滞及超过3.4秒的RR间期，大于2秒的停搏超过12000次（以夜间为主）；超声心动图显示左室射血分数轻度降低（49%）。基于指南推荐植入双腔频率应答起搏器，术后随访动态心电图。
AI.result: 患者成功植入双腔频率应答起搏器。随访动态心电图显示心律稳定、起搏有效，无临床显著心律失常，无超过2秒的停搏。术后临床情况稳定。摘要未报告具体统计比较或效应量。
AI.conclusion: 本病例表明，尽管存在显著电生理异常，严重房室传导障碍仍可能无临床症状。常规心电图筛查联合全面动态心电图监测对发现隐匿性高级别房室传导阻滞及识别高危患者至关重要。即使无症状，及时植入永久性双腔起搏器可有效稳定心律，是晚期房室传导障碍患者的首选治疗。局限性为单病例报告，结论需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景。高级别房室（AV）传导障碍与晕厥、严重血流动力学障碍及心源性猝死风险增加相关。尽管这些疾病通常表现为具有临床意义的症状，但部分患者尽管存在晚期传导异常仍可能保持无症状，这使得及时诊断和适当治疗尤为困难。此类病例对于职业活动要求高水平体能和持续备战状态的人群（包括军人）具有特殊临床重要性。

目的。呈现一例军人无症状性严重心动过缓伴一过性高级别房室传导阻滞的临床病例，描述诊断方法，并展示永久性双腔起搏器植入的有效性。

病例报告。一名军人接受常规医学检查，无任何心血管主诉，包括晕厥、头晕、呼吸困难或心悸。标准心电图显示严重心动过缓及二度房室传导阻滞（Mobitz II型）伴2:1传导。24小时动态心电图监测显示显著窦性心动过缓，平均心率40次/分，最低心率19次/分，多次发作一度和二度房室传导阻滞，反复发作高级别房室传导阻滞伴3:1传导，一过性完全性三度房室传导阻滞，以及超过3.4秒的RR间期停搏。记录到超过12,000次长于2秒的停搏，主要发生在夜间。超声心动图显示左心室收缩功能轻度减低，射血分数为49%。基于当前临床建议和记录的晚期传导异常，患者成功接受了双腔频率应答起搏器植入术。

结果。患者成功接受了双腔频率应答起搏器植入术。随访动态心电图监测显示心律稳定，起搏有效，无临床显著心律失常，无超过2秒的停搏。术后期间患者临床状况稳定。

结论。本病例强调，尽管存在显著的电生理异常，严重的房室传导障碍仍可能保持临床无症状。常规心电图筛查继以全面的动态心电图监测在发现隐匿性高级别房室传导阻滞和识别有潜在危及生命并发症风险的患者方面起着关键作用。及时植入永久性双腔起搏器可有效稳定心律，是晚期房室传导障碍患者的首选治疗，即使在没有临床症状的情况下也是如此。

title: Особенности ведения пациента с острым инфарктом миокарда, осложненным рецидивирующей фибрилляцией желудочков. Клинический случай
summary: Цели. Анализ клинического случая пациента с ОИМПST, осложненным рецидивирующей фибрилляцией желудочков, с отсроченным выполнением инвазивного вмешательства. Актуальность. Фибрилляция желудочков является тяжелым осложнением острого инфаркта миокарда, значительно утяжеляя прогноз. Методы. Использованы анамнестические и клинические данные пациента, ЭКГ-исследование и мониторирование, данные коронароангиографии и стентирования коронарных артерий. Результаты. Пациент К., 52 лет, доставлен СМП с диагнозом: острый коронарный синдром с подъемом сегмента ST, осложненный кардиогенным шоком. Ухудшение состояния за 1,5 часа до приезда СМП. ЭКГ: элевация ST в II, III, aVF, депрессия в V1-V2, ЧСС 54 уд. /мин., PQ 240 мс. От проведения коронароангиографии категорически отказался, проведенная тромболитическая терапия фортелизином без должного эффекта. На четвертые сутки после письменного согласия установлен временный ЭКС в режиме VVI по поводу АВ-блокады III степени, выполнено стентирование ПКА с восстановлением антеградного кровотока по TIMI II-III. На шестые сутки развилась фибрилляция желудочков (ФЖ), реанимационные мероприятия, включая дефибрилляцию 200 Дж (трижды), эффективны, восстановлен ритм ЭКС. На восьмые сутки три эпизода ФЖ в течение 6 часов, реанимационные мероприятия эффективны, дефибрилляция суммарно 35 раз, ЭКС отключен, затем удален. В последующем ведение пациента с постреанимационной болезнью продолжено мультидисциплинарной бригадой. Через неделю переведен в палату реабилитации, выписан на 23 день пребывания в стационаре в удовлетворительном состоянии. Фракция выброса после реанимационных мероприятий 35%, при выписке 53%, ЭхоКГ, выполненная через полгода: КДО 151 см3, КСО 62 см3, УО 89 см3, ФВ 59%, через год ФВ. Выводы. Данный клинический случай показывает возможность благоприятного исхода у пациента с рецидивирующей фибрилляцией желудочков с отсроченным проведением инвазивного вмешательства Objectives. To analyze a clinical case of a patient with STEMI complicated by recurrent ventricular fibrillation, with delayed invasive intervention. Background. Ventricular fibrillation is a severe complication of acute myocardial infarction, significantly worsening the prognosis. Methods. The patient's anamnestic and clinical data, ECG examination and monitoring, coronary angiography and coronary artery stenting data were used. Results. Patient K., 52 years old, was admitted to emergency medical services with a diagnosis of acute coronary syndrome with ST-segment elevation complicated by cardiogenic shock. His condition worsened 1.5 hours before the ambulance arrival. ECG: ST elevation in II, III, aVF, depression in V1-V2, HR 54 bpm, PQ 240 ms. He categorically refused coronary angiography; thrombolytic therapy with fortelizine was ineffective. On the fourth day, after written consent, a temporary pacemaker was inserted in VVI mode for third-degree atrioventricular block, and RCA stenting was performed, restoring antegrade blood flow according to TIMI II-III. On the sixth day, ventricular fibrillation (VF) developed. Resuscitation measures, including three 200 J defibrillations, were effective, and the pacemaker rhythm was restored. On the eighth day, three episodes of VF occurred over 6 hours. Resuscitation measures were effective, a total of 35 defibrillations were administered, and the pacemaker was disconnected and then removed. Subsequently, the patient's management of postresuscitation illness was continued by a multidisciplinary team. A week later, the patient was transferred to the rehabilitation ward and discharged on the 23rd day of his hospital stay in satisfactory condition. Ejection fraction after resuscitation was 35%, while at discharge it was 53%. Echocardiography performed six months later showed end-diastolic volume (EDV) of 151 cm³, end-diastolic volume (ESV) of 62 cm³, stroke volume (SV) of 89 cm³, and ejection fraction (EF) of 59%; after one year, EDV of 153 cm³, ESV of 60 cm³, SV of 93 cm³, and (EF of 60,7%. Conclusions: This clinical case demonstrates the possibility of a favorable outcome in a patient with recurrent ventricular fibrillation with delayed invasive intervention
journal: СИСТЕМНЫЙ АНАЛИЗ И УПРАВЛЕНИЕ В БИОМЕДИЦИНСКИХ СИСТЕМАХ

AI.tldr: 52岁STEMI合并心源性休克患者延迟血运重建后出现反复室颤，经多次除颤和综合管理，最终心功能恢复良好。
AI.motivation: 室颤是急性心肌梗死的严重并发症，显著恶化预后。对于延迟进行侵入性干预的患者，其室颤的管理和结局尚缺乏充分描述，本病例旨在探讨此类患者的临床经过和可能结局。
AI.method: 单病例报告。患者男性，52岁，因ST段抬高型急性冠脉综合征合并心源性休克入院。收集病史、心电图及监测、冠状动脉造影和支架植入资料。干预包括溶栓治疗、临时起搏器植入、右冠状动脉支架植入及反复除颤等复苏措施。主要观察临床经过、室颤发作及心功能变化。
AI.result: 患者初期拒绝冠脉造影，溶栓治疗无效。第4天植入临时VVI起搏器并行右冠状动脉支架植入，TIMI血流II-III级。第6天发生室颤，经3次200J除颤成功。第8天6小时内再发3次室颤，共除颤35次，随后拔除起搏器。复苏后EF 35%，出院时53%。6个月超声示EF 59%，1年EF 60.7%。第23天出院，状态满意。
AI.conclusion: 本病例显示，对于延迟侵入性干预的STEMI合并反复室颤患者，通过积极复苏和多学科管理仍可能获得良好预后。但单病例报告局限性大，不能推广至所有患者，需个体化决策。

summary_zh: 目的：分析一例急性ST段抬高型心肌梗死（ОИМПST）并发复发性心室颤动、且延迟行侵入性干预的患者的临床病例。背景：心室颤动是急性心肌梗死的严重并发症，显著加重预后。方法：采用患者的病史和临床数据、心电图检查及监测、冠状动脉造影和冠状动脉支架植入术数据。结果：患者K，52岁，由急救医疗服务（СМП）送达，诊断为：急性冠脉综合征伴ST段抬高，并发心源性休克。在急救人员到达前1.5小时病情恶化。心电图：II、III、aVF导联ST段抬高，V1-V2导联ST段压低，心率54次/分，PQ间期240毫秒。患者坚决拒绝冠状动脉造影，给予fortelizine的溶栓治疗未获应有疗效。第四天，在书面同意后，因三度房室传导阻滞植入临时心脏起搏器（ЭКС），模式为VVI，并完成右冠状动脉（ПКА）支架植入术，前向血流恢复至TIMI II-III级。第六天发生心室颤动（ФЖ），复苏措施包括200焦耳除颤（三次）有效，起搏器节律恢复。第八天，6小时内发生三次室颤发作，复苏措施有效，总计除颤35次，起搏器关闭，随后移除。此后，患者的复苏后疾病管理由多学科团队继续。一周后转入康复病房，住院第23天出院，状况满意。复苏措施后射血分数35%，出院时53%，半年后超声心动图：舒张末期容积（КДО）151 cm³，收缩末期容积（КСО）62 cm³，每搏输出量（УО）89 cm³，射血分数（ФВ）59%，一年后射血分数。结论：本临床病例表明，复发性心室颤动患者在接受延迟侵入性干预的情况下仍有可能获得良好结局。

title: PR INTERVAL ON RESTING ECG IN PATIENTS WITH MOBITZ-1 SECOND-DEGREE ATRIOVENTRICULAR BLOCK DETECTED ON AMBULATORY ECG MONITORING
summary: Prolonged PR interval is traditionally regarded as an electrocardiographic marker of delayed atrioventricular conduction and is known to predict future episodes of second- and third-degree atrioventricular block. Nevertheless, clinically significant episodes of second- and third-degree atrioventricular block may also occur in individuals with a normal PR interval on a standard resting electrocardiogram (ECG), indicating that normal baseline atrioventricular conduction does not exclude intermittent conduction abnormalities. Although Mobitz-1 second-degree atrioventricular block has long been considered a relatively benign rhythm disturbance, recent evidence has challenged this concept. A contemporary study demonstrated that the presence of Mobitz-1 atrioventricular block was associated with a 2.3-fold increase in the rate of cardiovascular death, suggesting that this conduction disorder may have greater clinical significance than previously believed. Current clinical guidelines recommend permanent pacemaker implantation for patients with Mobitz-2 second-degree atrioventricular block, infranodal 2:1 atrioventricular block, high-degree atrioventricular block, and third-degree atrioventricular block regardless of symptom status because of the substantial risk of progression to complete heart block. In contrast, permanent pacing in patients with Mobitz-1 second-degree atrioventricular block is generally indicated for those with symptoms attributable to bradycardia or for patients in whom electrophysiological evaluation demonstrates an intra-Hisian or infra-Hisian site of conduction delay. The study aimed to evaluate the relationship between the PR interval measured on a resting ECG and the occurrence of Mobitz-1 second-degree atrioventricular block detected by ambulatory ECG monitoring. Recordings from ambulatory ECG monitoring and corresponding resting ECGs of 40 patients with documented Mobitz-1 second-degree atrioventricular block were retrospectively analyzed. The median maximal PR interval recorded during ambulatory monitoring was 245.0 [212.5–305.0] ms, while the median maximal RR interval was 2038.0 [1819.0–2356.0] ms. On resting ECG, the median PR interval was 205.0 [167.5–245.0] ms. A prolonged PR interval (≥200 ms) on resting ECG was identified in 22 patients (55.0 %). Among these individuals, only 7 (17.5 %) patients had mild PR interval prolongation ranging from 200 to 220 ms, whereas the remaining patients exhibited more pronounced prolongation. Importantly, a normal PR interval (<200 ms) on resting ECG was observed in 18 patients (45.0 %) despite documented episodes of Mobitz-1 second-degree atrioventricular block during ambulatory ECG monitoring. There was a strong positive correlation was found between the PR interval measured on resting ECG and the maximal PR interval recorded during ambulatory monitoring (r = 0.76, p < 0.01). These findings demonstrate that nearly half of patients with Mobitz-1 second-degree atrioventricular block documented by ambulatory ECG monitoring have a normal PR interval on resting ECG. Consequently, the PR interval measured on a resting ECG should not be considered a reliable marker for excluding episodic Mobitz-1 second-degree atrioventricular block. Ambulatory ECG monitoring remains an essential diagnostic tool for detecting intermittent atrioventricular conduction disturbances that may not be apparent during routine resting ECG.

AI.tldr: 在40例动态心电图记录到Mobitz-1型二度房室传导阻滞的患者中，45%静息心电图PR间期正常，提示静息PR间期不能排除间歇性Mobitz-1型房室传导阻滞。
AI.motivation: PR间期延长传统上被视为房室传导延迟的标志，可预测未来发生二度及三度房室传导阻滞；但临床观察到静息PR间期正常者仍可出现有临床意义的二度/三度房室传导阻滞。同时，Mobitz-1型二度房室传导阻滞长期被认为相对良性，近期研究却提示其与心血管死亡风险增加2.3倍相关，其临床意义可能被低估。目前指南对Mobitz-1型患者的起搏指征主要依据症状及电生理检查定位，因此明确静息PR间期与动态心电图检出Mobitz-1型房室传导阻滞之间的关系具有临床价值。
AI.method: 回顾性研究。纳入40例经动态心电图监测记录到Mobitz-1型二度房室传导阻滞的患者，分析其动态心电图与相应静息心电图资料。比较静息心电图PR间期与动态监测中最大PR间期、最大RR间期，并以PR间期≥200 ms定义延长，采用相关分析评估静息PR间期与动态最大PR间期的关系。摘要未报告终点定义细节及具体统计方法。
AI.result: 动态监测中最大PR间期中位数为245.0 [212.5–305.0] ms，最大RR间期中位数为2038.0 [1819.0–2356.0] ms；静息心电图PR间期中位数为205.0 [167.5–245.0] ms。静息PR间期延长（≥200 ms）者22例（55.0%），其中仅7例（17.5%）为200–220 ms的轻度延长，其余延长更明显。静息PR间期正常（<200 ms）者18例（45.0%），但均经动态心电图记录到Mobitz-1型二度房室传导阻滞。静息PR间期与动态监测最大PR间期呈强正相关（r=0.76，p<0.01）。
AI.conclusion: 近半数经动态心电图证实Mobitz-1型二度房室传导阻滞的患者静息心电图PR间期正常，因此静息PR间期不能作为排除间歇性Mobitz-1型房室传导阻滞的可靠指标；对疑有间歇性房室传导障碍者，动态心电图监测仍是必要的诊断工具。本研究为单中心小样本回顾性分析，结果需更大规模前瞻性研究验证，但提示临床不应仅凭静息PR间期正常而低估传导阻滞风险。

summary_zh: PR间期延长传统上被视为房室传导延迟的心电图标志，并已知可预测未来发生二度和三度房室传导阻滞。然而，临床上显著的第二度和第三度房室传导阻滞事件也可能发生在标准静息心电图（ECG）上PR间期正常的个体中，这表明正常的基线房室传导并不能排除间歇性传导异常。尽管Mobitz-1型第二度房室传导阻滞长期以来被认为是一种相对良性的心律紊乱，但近期证据对这一概念提出了挑战。一项当代研究表明，Mobitz-1型房室传导阻滞的存在与心血管死亡率增加2.3倍相关，提示这种传导障碍可能具有比以往认为的更重要的临床意义。当前临床指南推荐，对于Mobitz-2型第二度房室传导阻滞、结下2:1房室传导阻滞、高度房室传导阻滞和第三度房室传导阻滞的患者，无论症状状态如何，均建议植入永久起搏器，因为进展为完全性心脏传导阻滞的风险很高。相比之下，对于Mobitz-1型第二度房室传导阻滞患者，永久起搏通常适用于有心动过缓相关症状的患者，或电生理检查显示传导延迟位于希氏束内或希氏束下的患者。本研究旨在评估静息ECG测量的PR间期与动态ECG监测检测到的Mobitz-1型第二度房室传导阻滞发生之间的关系。回顾性分析了40例记录有Mobitz-1型第二度房室传导阻滞患者的动态ECG监测记录和相应的静息ECG。动态监测期间记录的最大PR间期中位数为245.0 [212.5–305.0] ms，而最大RR间期中位数为2038.0 [1819.0–2356.0] ms。在静息ECG上，PR间期中位数为205.0 [167.5–245.0] ms。22例患者（55.0%）在静息ECG上发现PR间期延长（≥200 ms）。在这些个体中，仅7例（17.5%）患者PR间期轻度延长，范围为200至220 ms，而其余患者则表现出更明显的延长。重要的是，尽管动态ECG监测期间记录了Mobitz-1型第二度房室传导阻滞发作，但18例患者（45.0%）在静息ECG上PR间期正常（<200 ms）。静息ECG测量的PR间期与动态监测期间记录的最大PR间期之间存在强正相关（r = 0.76，p < 0.01）。这些发现表明，近一半经动态ECG监测记录的Mobitz-1型第二度房室传导阻滞患者在静息ECG上PR间期正常。因此，静息ECG测量的PR间期不应被视为排除阵发性Mobitz-1型第二度房室传导阻滞的可靠标志。动态ECG监测仍然是检测常规静息ECG期间可能不明显的间歇性房室传导障碍的重要诊断工具。

title: Сontemporary prospects for the use of leadless cardiac pacemakers
summary: Background: Cardiovascular diseases remain the leading cause of mortality worldwide, accounting for more than 30% of all deaths. Traditional transvenous pacemakers are widely used; however, the complication rate after implantation reaches 10–15%. Leadless pacemakers significantly reduce the risk of complications, with rates of approximately 0.46% within 90 days and 1.77% within one year. Therefore, this technology is considered a promising direction in modern cardiac pacing. The aim is analyzing current scientific evidence on the use of leadless pacemakers. Materials and Methods. For the preparation of this literature review, contemporary scientific publications devoted to the clinical application, efficacy, safety, and future prospects of leadless pacemakers were analyzed. The literature search was conducted in the PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar databases for the period from 2015 to 2026. Original studies, meta-analyses, systematic reviews, and clinical guidelines published in English and Russian were included. Publications without full-text access, duplicate data, and studies lacking clinical relevance were excluded. Results. The literature analysis demonstrated that leadless pacemakers show high efficacy and safety, characterized by a low rate of complications and stable pacing parameters. Their use reduces the risk of infections, thrombosis, and lead dysfunction compared with traditional transvenous systems. Conclusions. Leadless cardiac pacing is a promising direction in modern cardiology. Further technological development and expansion of indications will improve the effectiveness of arrhythmia management and clinical outcomes in patients.

AI.tldr: 无导线起搏器较传统经静脉起搏器显著降低并发症风险（90天约0.46%，1年约1.77%），起搏参数稳定，是心律失常器械治疗的重要发展方向。
AI.motivation: 心血管疾病是全球首位死因，传统经静脉起搏器植入后并发症发生率高达10%–15%，包括感染、血栓形成和导线功能障碍等，临床亟需更安全的起搏方案；无导线起搏器被认为可显著降低并发症风险，但其临床应用证据需系统梳理。
AI.method: 本文为文献综述，检索PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar数据库2015–2026年间发表的英文和俄文文献，纳入原始研究、荟萃分析、系统综述和临床指南，排除无全文、重复数据及缺乏临床相关性的研究，分析无导线起搏器的临床应用、疗效、安全性和前景。
AI.result: 文献分析显示无导线起搏器疗效和安全性高，并发症发生率低（90天内约0.46%，1年内约1.77%），起搏参数稳定；与传统经静脉系统相比，可降低感染、血栓形成和导线功能障碍风险。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 无导线心脏起搏是现代心脏病学有前景的方向，进一步技术发展和适应证扩展有望改善心律失常管理和临床结局；但本综述为叙述性文献分析，缺乏定量合并数据，结论需以大规模随机对照研究进一步验证。

summary_zh: 背景：心血管疾病仍然是全球死亡的主要原因，占所有死亡人数的30%以上。传统的经静脉起搏器被广泛使用；然而，植入后的并发症发生率高达10–15%。无导线起搏器显著降低了并发症风险，90天内并发症发生率约为0.46%，一年内约为1.77%。因此，该技术被认为是现代心脏起搏领域的一个有前景的方向。目的：分析关于无导线起搏器使用的当前科学证据。材料与方法：为准备本文献综述，分析了致力于无导线起搏器的临床应用、有效性、安全性和未来前景的当代科学出版物。文献检索在PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar数据库中进行，时间范围为2015年至2026年。纳入以英文和俄文发表的原创研究、荟萃分析、系统综述和临床指南。排除无全文访问权限的出版物、重复数据以及缺乏临床相关性的研究。结果：文献分析表明，无导线起搏器显示出高有效性和安全性，其特征是并发症发生率低和起搏参数稳定。与传统经静脉系统相比，其使用降低了感染、血栓形成和导线功能障碍的风险。结论：无导线心脏起搏是现代心脏病学的一个有前景的方向。进一步的技术发展和适应症的扩大将改善心律失常管理和患者的临床结局。

title: The medial septum model as a pacemaker of theta rhythm: the key role of short-term synaptic plasticity
summary: The hippocampal theta rhythm is crucial for memory and navigation. It is paced by parvalbumin-expressing GABAergic neurons in the medial septum. These neurons segregate into two subpopulations-Teevra and Komal cells-which fire in anti-phase bursts at theta frequency, with a stable phase shift of approximately 150 degrees, and exhibit mutual inhibition. While essential, the network mechanism enabling this stable anti-phase synchronization remains unresolved, as previous models relying on intrinsic neuronal adaptation or external rhythmic inputs conflict with experimental evidence. Here, we propose a novel computational model demonstrating that short-term synaptic depression (STD) within the reciprocal inhibitory circuit between these populations is sufficient to generate and stabilize the observed anti-phase theta oscillations. The model consists of two homogeneous populations of fast-spiking (Izhikevich model) neurons, connected via depressing synapses governed by Tsodyks-Markram dynamics. Using numerical simulation and optimization, we identify parameter regimes that robustly produce oscillations with the target 150-degree phase lag. Our analysis reveals that the balance of synaptic strengths is critical for initiating collective rhythmicity, while the time constants of neurotransmitter recovery ([Formula: see text]) and facilitation ([Formula: see text]) primarily control the precise phase relationship. The model reproduces key experimental features: sharp transitions to rhythmic states, frequency in the 4-5 Hz theta band, and independent control of oscillation amplitude and frequency by external excitatory drive and synaptic weights. The rhythm is stable over a wide parameter range, with frequency increasing with external drive but decreasing with stronger synaptic coupling. We conclude that STD provides a parsimonious and biologically plausible negative feedback mechanism to stabilize anti-phase pacing in the medial septum, effectively explaining the endogenous generation of hippocampal theta rhythm without requiring intrinsic pacemaking or phasic external inputs. This work highlights the fundamental role of network dynamics and short-term plasticity in producing critical brain rhythms.

AI.tldr: 计算模型表明，内侧隔核Teevra与Komal细胞间抑制性突触的短期突触抑制足以产生并稳定约150度反相的theta节律，无需内在起搏或外部节律输入。
AI.motivation: 海马theta节律对记忆和导航至关重要，由内侧隔核表达小清蛋白的GABA能神经元起搏。这些神经元分为Teevra和Komal两个亚群，以theta频率反相爆发，相位差稳定在约150度，并存在相互抑制。然而，这种稳定反相同步的网络机制尚未明确，既往依赖内在神经元适应或外部节律输入的模型与实验证据相矛盾。
AI.method: 研究为计算建模研究，提出一个由两个均质快速放电（Izhikevich模型）神经元群体组成的网络模型，群体间通过Tsodyks-Markram动力学支配的抑制性突触连接，并包含短期突触抑制（STD）。通过数值模拟和优化，识别能稳健产生目标150度相位滞后振荡的参数区域，并分析突触强度平衡及神经递质恢复和易化时间常数对振荡的影响。
AI.result: 模型稳健产生4-5 Hz theta频段振荡，相位滞后约150度。突触强度平衡对启动集体节律性至关重要，而神经递质恢复时间常数和易化时间常数主要控制精确相位关系。模型重现了关键实验特征：向节律状态的锐利转换、振荡幅度与频率分别由外部兴奋性驱动和突触权重独立控制；节律在宽参数范围内稳定，频率随外部驱动增加而升高，随突触耦合增强而降低。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: STD为内侧隔核反相起搏的稳定提供了一种简约且生物学合理的负反馈机制，可解释海马theta节律的内源性产生，无需内在起搏或相位性外部输入。该工作强调网络动力学和短期可塑性在产生关键脑节律中的基本作用，对理解theta节律相关生理及病理机制具有理论意义，但结论基于计算模型，尚需实验验证。

summary_zh: 海马theta节律对记忆和导航至关重要。它由内侧隔核中表达小清蛋白的GABA能神经元起搏。这些神经元分为两个亚群——Teevra细胞和Komal细胞——它们以theta频率反相爆发放电，相位差稳定在约150度，并表现出相互抑制。尽管这一现象至关重要，但实现这种稳定反相同步的网络机制仍未解决，因为先前依赖于神经元内在适应或外部节律输入的模型与实验证据相冲突。在此，我们提出一种新的计算模型，证明在这些群体之间的相互抑制回路中，短期突触抑制（STD）足以产生并稳定观察到的反相theta振荡。该模型由两个同质的快速放电（Izhikevich模型）神经元群体组成，通过受Tsodyks-Markram动力学支配的抑制性突触连接。通过数值模拟和优化，我们确定了能够稳健产生目标150度相位滞后振荡的参数区域。我们的分析揭示，突触强度的平衡对于启动集体节律性至关重要，而神经递质恢复（[公式：见正文]）和易化（[公式：见正文]）的时间常数主要控制精确的相位关系。该模型再现了关键实验特征：向节律状态的急剧转变、4-5 Hz theta频段的频率，以及通过外部兴奋性驱动和突触权重独立控制振荡幅度和频率。该节律在广泛的参数范围内稳定，频率随外部驱动增加而增加，但随突触耦合增强而降低。我们得出结论，STD提供了一种简约且生物学上合理的负反馈机制，以稳定内侧隔核中的反相起搏，有效解释了海马theta节律的内源性产生，而无需内在起搏或相位性外部输入。这项工作突出了网络动力学和短期可塑性在产生关键脑节律中的基本作用。

title: A Prospective Study of Comparison of Left Ventricular Volumes and Function by 2D and 3D Transthoracic Echocardiography in Patients With Left Ventricular Systolic Dysfunction.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Accurate assessment of left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) and volumes is pivotal for stratifying heart‑failure severity and guiding device or revascularisation therapy. Two‑dimensional echocardiography (2DE) is ubiquitous, yet geometric assumptions impair precision. Three‑dimensional echocardiography (3DE) offers improved spatial resolution, but its added value in routine practice is under‑reported.

OBJECTIVES: The objectives of this study were to compare 2DE‑ and 3DE‑derived LVEF and volumes in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, quantify reclassification rates (patients whose classification of the severity of LV systolic dysfunction changes between 2DE and 3DE), and identify subgroups benefiting most from 3DE (e.g., patients having moderate LV systolic dysfunction by 2DE who were found to have severe LV systolic dysfunction by 3DE were advised for implantable cardioverter-defibrillator or cardiac resynchronisation therapy).

METHODS: This prospective observational study enrolled 104 patients with left ventricular systolic dysfunction (ejection fraction (EF) <50%) at Kalinga Institute of Medical Sciences between March 2020 and September 2022. Two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) were performed using a Philips Epiq™ 7 system with S5-1 and X5-1 transducers, respectively. LV volumes and EF were measured using Simpson's biplane and Teichholz methods for 2DE, and full-volume acquisition for 3DE. Visual EF estimation ("eyeballing") was also recorded. Intra-modality and inter-modality comparisons were analysed using paired t-tests, Pearson correlation coefficients, and Bland-Altman plots.

RESULTS: Three-dimensional datasets were successfully acquired in 102 (98.1%) of 104 patients. The mean age was 56.4±11.5 years, with 72 (69.2%) male patients. EF measured by 3DE (34.8±11.9%) was significantly lower compared to that measured by 2D Teichholz (37±10.4%) and Simpson's method (37.1±12.8%; p<0.001). Eyeballing EF (34.9±10.1%) showed the strongest correlation with 3DE (r=0.701). Strong correlations were observed between 3DE- and 2DE-derived volumes (end-diastolic volume (EDV) r=0.82-0.83; end-systolic volume (ESV) r=0.83-0.86), though Bland-Altman analysis showed wide limits of agreement. 3DE reclassified 17 (43.5%) of 39 patients with moderate LV systolic dysfunction by 2DE into the severe dysfunction category. Regional wall motion abnormality (RWMA) was identified in 69 (67.6%) patients by 3DE versus 39 (38.5%) by 2DE. Correlation between 2DE and 3DE was better in patients with global hypokinesia than in those with RWMA. Image acquisition and analysis averaged 23.1±3.8 minutes.

CONCLUSIONS: Adding 3DE to routine 2DE refines quantification of LVEF, ventricular volumes, and regional function, reclassifying nearly half of borderline cases and potentially altering defibrillator or resynchronisation therapy recommendations. Where 3DE is unavailable, expert visual estimation outperforms formula‑based 2DE in approximating 3DE accuracy and risk stratification in daily practice.

AI.tldr: 在左室收缩功能不全患者中，3D超声心动图测得的LVEF显著低于2D，并将43.5%的2D中度功能不全患者重分类为重度，可能影响ICD或CRT决策。
AI.motivation: 准确评估左室射血分数（LVEF）和容积对心衰严重程度分层及器械或血运重建治疗决策至关重要。2D超声心动图广泛使用但受几何假设限制，3D超声心动图空间分辨率更优，但其在常规实践中的附加价值尚缺乏充分报告。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性研究，纳入104例左室收缩功能不全（EF<50%）患者，于2020年3月至2022年9月在Kalinga医学科学研究所进行。使用Philips Epiq 7系统分别行2D（S5-1探头）和3D（X5-1探头）经胸超声心动图，2D采用Simpson双平面法和Teichholz法测量，3D采用全容积采集。记录视觉EF估测（eyeballing）。采用配对t检验、Pearson相关系数和Bland-Altman图进行组内和组间比较。
AI.result: 3D数据集在102例（98.1%）患者中成功获取。平均年龄56.4±11.5岁，男性72例（69.2%）。3D测得的EF（34.8±11.9%）显著低于2D Teichholz法（37±10.4%）和Simpson法（37.1±12.8%；p<0.001）。视觉估测EF（34.9±10.1%）与3D相关性最强（r=0.701）。3D与2D容积相关性良好（EDV r=0.82-0.83；ESV r=0.83-0.86），但Bland-Altman分析显示一致性界限较宽。3D将39例2D中度左室收缩功能不全患者中的17例（43.5%）重分类为重度。3D识别出69例（67.6%）节段性室壁运动异常（RWMA），而2D仅识别39例（38.5%）。整体运动减弱患者中2D与3D相关性优于RWMA患者。图像采集和分析平均耗时23.1±3.8分钟。
AI.conclusion: 在常规2D基础上增加3D可优化LVEF、心室容积和区域功能的定量评估，将近半数临界病例重分类，可能改变除颤器或再同步化治疗建议。在无3D条件下，专家视觉估测在近似3D准确性和风险分层方面优于基于公式的2D。本研究为单中心观察性设计，样本量有限，3D的临床获益仍需更大规模结局研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：准确评估左心室射血分数（LVEF）和容积对于心力衰竭严重程度分层以及指导器械或血运重建治疗至关重要。二维超声心动图（2DE）应用广泛，但其几何假设会影响精确性。三维超声心动图（3DE）提供了更好的空间分辨率，但其在常规实践中的附加价值报道不足。

目的：本研究旨在比较射血分数降低的心力衰竭患者中2DE和3DE衍生的LVEF和容积，量化重新分类率（即2DE与3DE之间左心室收缩功能障碍严重程度分类发生变化的患者比例），并确定从3DE中获益最大的亚组（例如，2DE显示中度左心室收缩功能障碍而3DE发现严重左心室收缩功能障碍的患者被建议植入植入式心律转复除颤器或接受心脏再同步治疗）。

方法：这项前瞻性观察性研究在2020年3月至2022年9月期间于Kalinga医学科学研究所纳入了104例左心室收缩功能障碍（射血分数（EF）<50%）患者。分别使用Philips Epiq™ 7系统配合S5-1和X5-1探头进行二维（2D）和三维（3D）经胸超声心动图（TTE）检查。2DE采用Simpson双平面法和Teichholz法测量左心室容积和EF，3DE采用全容积采集。同时记录视觉EF估测（“目测法”）。采用配对t检验、Pearson相关系数和Bland-Altman图分析模态内和模态间比较。

结果：104例患者中102例（98.1%）成功获取三维数据集。平均年龄为56.4±11.5岁，男性患者72例（69.2%）。3DE测量的EF（34.8±11.9%）显著低于2D Teichholz法（37±10.4%）和Simpson法（37.1±12.8%；p<0.001）。目测EF（34.9±10.1%）与3DE相关性最强（r=0.701）。3DE与2DE衍生的容积之间观察到强相关性（舒张末期容积（EDV）r=0.82-0.83；收缩末期容积（ESV）r=0.83-0.86），但Bland-Altman分析显示一致性界限较宽。3DE将2DE判定为中度左心室收缩功能障碍的39例患者中的17例（43.5%）重新分类为严重功能障碍类别。3DE识别出69例（67.6%）患者存在节段性室壁运动异常（RWMA），而2DE为39例（38.5%）。2DE与3DE之间的相关性在整体运动减弱患者中优于RWMA患者。图像采集和分析平均耗时23.1±3.8分钟。

结论：在常规2DE基础上增加3DE可优化LVEF、心室容积和区域功能的定量评估，将近半数临界病例重新分类，并可能改变除颤器或再同步治疗建议。在无法使用3DE的情况下，专家视觉估测在接近3DE准确性和日常实践风险分层方面优于基于公式的2DE。

title: DUAL-CHAMBER PACEMAKER IMPLANTATION THROUGH A PERSISTENT LEFT SUPERIOR VENA CAVA WITH ABSENT RIGHT SUPERIOR VENA CAVA: THE ALPHA-LOOP TECHNIQUE
summary: Persistent left superior vena cava (PLSVC) is the most common thoracic venous anomaly, but its coexistence with an absent right superior vena cava (RSVC) is uncommon and may make transvenous cardiac device implantation technically challenging. A 56-year-old woman with recurrent syncope and complete atrioventricular block underwent temporary pacing followed by planned dual-chamber permanent pacemaker implantation. Left -sided venography demonstrat ed drainage through a PLSVC into the coronary sinus and right atrium. Right-sided venography showed drainage through the innominate vein into the PLSVC, confirming absence of the RSVC. Because the coronary sinus-to-tricuspid valve trajectory was unfavorable for direct right ventricular lead delivery, the ventricular lead was advanced through the PLSVC and coronary sinus into the right atrium, and an alpha-loop was created using stylet manipulation. This facilitated prolapse of the lead across the tricuspid valve and stable positioning at the right ventricular apex. A right atrial lead was also successfully positioned, and satisfactory acute pacing parameters were obtained. Recognition of anomalous systemic venous anatomy and deliberate loop formation can permit conventional transvenous dual-chamber pacing in patients with PLSVC and absent RSVC.

AI.tldr: 在永存左上腔静脉合并右上腔静脉缺如的患者中，采用alpha-loop技术可成功完成双腔起搏器植入，急性起搏参数满意。
AI.motivation: 永存左上腔静脉（PLSVC）是最常见的胸部静脉异常，但合并右上腔静脉（RSVC）缺如罕见，导致经静脉植入心脏器械技术困难，缺乏标准化操作策略。
AI.method: 病例报告。56岁女性，反复晕厥，完全性房室传导阻滞，先行临时起搏后计划植入双腔永久起搏器。左侧静脉造影显示PLSVC经冠状静脉窦引流入右心房；右侧造影显示经无名静脉引流入PLSVC，证实RSVC缺如。因冠状静脉窦至三尖瓣路径不利于直接递送右心室导线，采用PLSVC-冠状静脉窦-右心房路径，通过操作导丝形成alpha-loop，使导线越过三尖瓣并稳定定位于右室心尖部，同时成功放置右心房导线。
AI.result: 成功植入双腔起搏器，右心室导线经alpha-loop技术稳定定位于右室心尖部，右心房导线成功放置，急性起搏参数满意。摘要未报告具体起搏参数数值及随访结果。
AI.conclusion: 对于PLSVC合并RSVC缺如患者，识别异常静脉解剖并有意形成alpha-loop可允许常规经静脉双腔起搏。该技术为器械植入提供了可行策略，但为单例报告，需更多病例验证其可重复性和长期安全性。

summary_zh: 永存左上腔静脉（PLSVC）是最常见的胸部静脉异常，但其与右上腔静脉（RSVC）缺如并存的情况并不常见，可能使经静脉心脏装置植入在技术上具有挑战性。一名56岁女性，因反复晕厥和完全性房室传导阻滞，接受了临时起搏，随后计划行双腔永久起搏器植入。左侧静脉造影显示经PLSVC引流入冠状静脉窦和右心房。右侧静脉造影显示经无名静脉引流入PLSVC，证实RSVC缺如。由于冠状静脉窦至三尖瓣的轨迹不利于右心室导线直接输送，心室导线经PLSVC和冠状静脉窦推进至右心房，并通过 stylet 操作创建了 alpha 环。这促进了导线脱垂跨越三尖瓣并稳定定位于右心室心尖部。右心房导线也成功定位，并获得了满意的急性起搏参数。识别异常体静脉解剖结构并有意识地成环，可以使PLSVC合并RSVC缺如的患者接受常规经静脉双腔起搏。

title: A 3-year chronic post-sternotomy sinus tract maintained by a migrating pacemaker wire
summary: Chronic chest wall discharge following median sternotomy is a complex complication requiring a stepwise therapeutic approach. We present a 26-year-old male patient who underwent emergent mechanical mitral valve replacement for infective endocarditis and developed delayed sternal healing with persistent sterile discharge in the postoperative period. Suspecting a local tissue reaction, the ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) sternal bands were sequentially removed. Despite extracting all closure materials and excluding infection via negative tissue cultures, the chronic sinus tract discharge persisted for two years, necessitating regular wound care. A multidisciplinary surgical revision was performed to determine the underlying etiology. Exploration revealed that a temporary epicardial pacemaker wire had migrated anteriorly from the mediastinum into the subcutaneous tissue, presumably through a previous sternal band hole. Complete extraction of the retained wire, combined with short-term vacuum-assisted closure therapy, led to rapid and sustained wound healing. This case highlights that delayed sternal healing can be perpetuated by sequential foreign body reactions, and migrating pacemaker wires must be considered in persistent post-sternotomy sinus tracts.

AI.tldr: 26岁男性机械二尖瓣置换术后胸骨正中切开处慢性窦道渗液3年，最终证实为临时心表起搏导线迁移至皮下组织所致，取出导线后伤口愈合。
AI.motivation: 胸骨正中切开术后慢性胸壁渗液/窦道是复杂并发症，需逐步排查处理。既往多关注感染、胸骨固定材料异物反应，而对留置的临时心表起搏导线迁移作为持续窦道病因的认识不足，易导致长期误诊与反复清创。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。26岁男性，因感染性心内膜炎行急诊机械二尖瓣置换，术后出现胸骨愈合延迟并持续无菌性渗液。先怀疑局部组织反应，依次取出超高分子量聚乙烯（UHMWPE）胸骨绑带；组织培养阴性排除感染，但窦道渗液仍持续2年、需定期换药。随后行多学科手术探查明确病因，取出迁移导线并辅以短期负压辅助闭合（VAC）治疗。摘要未报告定量终点与统计方法。
AI.result: 探查发现一根临时心表起搏导线自纵隔经原胸骨绑带孔向前迁移至皮下组织。完整取出残留导线并联合短期VAC后，伤口迅速且持续愈合。摘要未报告具体愈合时间、随访时长及统计学数值。
AI.conclusion: 胸骨切开术后迁延不愈的窦道可由序贯性异物反应维持，迁移的临时心表起搏导线应纳入鉴别诊断；彻底取出异物是治愈关键。提示对术后慢性窦道应尽早影像学评估与手术探查，避免反复盲目清创。局限性为单例报告，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: 背景：正中胸骨切开术后慢性胸壁渗液是一种复杂的并发症，需要采取逐步的治疗方法。我们报告一名26岁男性患者，因感染性心内膜炎接受急诊机械二尖瓣置换术，术后出现胸骨愈合延迟并伴有持续性无菌性渗液。怀疑局部组织反应，遂依次移除超高分子量聚乙烯（UHMWPE）胸骨带。尽管取出了所有闭合材料并通过组织培养阴性排除了感染，慢性窦道渗液仍持续两年，需要定期伤口护理。方法：进行了多学科手术探查以确定潜在病因。结果：探查发现一根临时心外膜起搏导线从纵隔向前迁移至皮下组织，推测是通过先前的胸骨带孔。完全取出残留导线并结合短期负压辅助闭合治疗，实现了快速且持续的伤口愈合。结论：本病例强调，胸骨愈合延迟可因序贯性异物反应而持续存在，在持续性胸骨切开术后窦道中必须考虑起搏导线迁移的可能。

title: Analisis Uji Kalibrasi Alat Kejut Jantung Menggunakan Defibrillator Analyzer
summary: Alat kejut jantung merupakan peralatan penunjang hidup kedaruratan yang esensial untuk memulihkan ritme jantung pasien melalui induksi kejut listrik. Mengingat fungsi kritisnya, sekecil apa pun penyimpangan pada energi keluaran maupun durasi waktu pengisian daya dapat berakibat fatal bagi keselamatan pasien. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis tingkat kelaikan operasional lima unit alat kejut jantung di sebuah fasilitas pelayanan kesehatan melalui serangkaian uji kalibrasi teknis. Pendekatan observasi lapangan secara kuantitatif diterapkan menggunakan instrumen kalibrator Defibrillator Analyzer dan Electrical Safety Analyzer. Parameter yang dievaluasi secara komprehensif mencakup inspeksi kondisi fisik, tingkat kebocoran arus listrik, akurasi keluaran energi pada rentang 5 hingga 300 Joule, persentase kehilangan energi, serta waktu pengisian daya maksimum. Data hasil pengukuran kemudian diolah secara statistik untuk menentukan nilai ketidakpastian bentangan dan dikomparasikan terhadap batas toleransi yang ditetapkan dalam Metode Kerja Pengujian dan Kalibrasi Kementerian Kesehatan Republik Indonesia. Hasil analisis menunjukkan bahwa seluruh sampel lolos pengujian keamanan kelistrikan dengan tingkat kebocoran arus tertinggi tercatat hanya sebesar 28,9 µA, jauh di bawah ambang batas kritis 500 µA. Evaluasi akurasi energi dan persentase kehilangan energi (energy loss rate) menghasilkan deviasi yang secara konsisten berada di dalam rentang toleransi maksimal 15%, dengan penyusutan tertinggi sebesar 8,60%. Selain itu, durasi waktu pengisian daya (charge time) seluruh unit tercatat sangat responsif pada rentang 4,26 hingga 6,48 detik, memenuhi batas aman 15 detik. Nilai ketidakpastian bentangan () tertinggi yang diperoleh hanya sebesar 0,66 J, membuktikan presisi pengukuran yang sangat baik. Kesimpulannya, seluruh unit alat kejut jantung tersebut dinyatakan laik pakai dan terjamin keandalannya untuk mendukung standar keselamatan pasien secara optimal.

AI.tldr: 五台除颤器经校准检测均合格，漏电流最高28.9 µA，能量偏差最大8.60%，充电时间4.26-6.48秒，均符合安全标准。
AI.motivation: 除颤器是关键的急救生命支持设备，其能量输出或充电时间的微小偏差都可能危及患者安全，因此需要通过校准检测评估其操作可靠性。
AI.method: 采用定量现场观察研究，使用除颤器分析仪和电气安全分析仪对某医疗机构五台除颤器进行校准测试。评估参数包括物理状况检查、漏电流、5-300 J能量输出精度、能量损失百分比及最大充电时间。测量数据经统计处理确定扩展不确定度，并与印尼卫生部测试校准工作方法规定的容差限值比较。
AI.result: 所有样本通过电气安全测试，最高漏电流仅28.9 µA，远低于500 µA临界阈值。能量精度和能量损失率偏差均在最大15%容差范围内，最高损失为8.60%。所有设备充电时间在4.26至6.48秒之间，满足15秒安全限值。最高扩展不确定度仅为0.66 J，表明测量精度良好。
AI.conclusion: 所有除颤器均判定为可安全使用，可靠性有保障，能有效支持患者安全标准。定期校准检测对确保除颤器性能至关重要，但本研究样本量小且限于单一机构，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: 心脏电击设备是急诊生命支持的关键设备，通过电击诱导恢复患者心脏节律。鉴于其关键功能，输出能量或充电时间即使出现微小偏差，也可能对患者安全造成致命后果。本研究旨在通过一系列技术校准测试，分析某医疗机构五台心脏电击设备的操作适用性。采用定量现场观察方法，使用校准器Defibrillator Analyzer和Electrical Safety Analyzer。全面评估的参数包括物理状况检查、漏电流水平、5至300焦耳范围内的能量输出准确性、能量损失百分比以及最大充电时间。测量数据随后进行统计处理以确定扩展不确定度值，并与印度尼西亚共和国卫生部测试和校准工作方法中规定的容差限值进行比较。分析结果表明，所有样本均通过电气安全测试，记录的最高漏电流仅为28.9 µA，远低于500 µA的关键阈值。能量准确性和能量损失率（energy loss rate）评估产生的偏差始终在最大15%的容差范围内，最高衰减为8.60%。此外，所有单元的充电时间（charge time）记录在4.26至6.48秒范围内，响应非常迅速，满足15秒的安全限值。获得的最高扩展不确定度（）值仅为0.66 J，证明测量精度极佳。总之，所有心脏电击设备单元均被声明为适用且可靠性得到保证，以最佳方式支持患者安全标准。

title: 5G Cloud-Enabled Telemedicine for Remote Management of Heart Failure Patients With Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators: A Multicenter Open-Label Randomized Controlled Trial.
summary: Postoperative follow-up for patients with implantable cardioverter-defibrillators and cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillators (ICD/CRT-D) is often delayed in remote areas because of geographic barriers and limited healthcare resources, increasing the risk of adverse outcomes. The "Make Changes" study, was a prospective, multicenter, open-label randomized trial evaluating a 5G-cloud technology platform (5G-CTP) for real-time remote device interrogation and reprogramming versus standard In-clinic care. Between October 2022 and February 2024, 206 patients from five centers were randomly assigned to 12 months of follow-up with 5G-CTP (n = 104) or In-clinic care (n = 102). For the primary endpoint of time from clinical event to intervention, the 5G-CTP group had a significantly shorter response time than the In-Clinic group (4.2 vs. 11.5 days; p < 0.001). For secondary endpoints, the 5G-CTP group showed greater improvement in life quality at 12 months based on Minnesota Living with Heart Failure Questionnaire (p = 0.012). Rates of unplanned visits and clinical interventions were similar between groups, with no procedure-related complications. This model integrates community hospitals with implantation centers through 5G networks, enabling timely specialist-directed care locally without long-distance travel. It is a feasible strategy for postoperative ICD/CRT-D management, particularly in underserved regions with limited access to specialized cardiac care.

AI.tldr: 在植入ICD/CRT-D的心衰患者中，5G云平台远程随访较门诊随访显著缩短临床事件至干预时间（4.2 vs 11.5天，P<0.001），并改善12个月生活质量。
AI.motivation: 偏远地区ICD/CRT-D患者术后随访因地理障碍和医疗资源有限常被延迟，增加不良结局风险；既往缺乏评估5G云技术平台用于器械实时远程程控与再编程的随机对照证据。
AI.method: 前瞻性、多中心、开放标签随机对照试验（Make Changes研究），2022年10月至2024年2月纳入5家中心206例ICD/CRT-D患者，随机分为5G云技术平台（5G-CTP）随访12个月组（n=104）与标准门诊随访组（n=102）；主要终点为临床事件至干预的时间，次要终点包括12个月明尼苏达心衰生活质量问卷评分、非计划就诊与临床干预率及手术相关并发症。
AI.result: 5G-CTP组主要终点响应时间显著短于门诊组（4.2 vs 11.5天，p<0.001）；12个月生活质量改善更明显（MLHFQ，p=0.012）；两组非计划就诊率和临床干预率相似，未发生操作相关并发症。
AI.conclusion: 5G云平台通过连接社区医院与植入中心，实现专家指导下的本地及时管理，是ICD/CRT-D术后随访的可行策略，尤其适用于专科心脏诊疗可及性不足的地区；但研究为开放标签设计、样本量有限、随访12个月，对硬终点（如住院和死亡）的影响尚未明确。

summary_zh: 植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）和心脏再同步治疗除颤器（CRT-D）患者的术后随访常因地理障碍和医疗资源有限而在偏远地区延迟，增加了不良结局的风险。"Make Changes"研究是一项前瞻性、多中心、开放标签随机试验，评估5G云技术平台（5G-CTP）用于实时远程设备询问和重编程与标准门诊护理的比较。2022年10月至2024年2月，来自五个中心的206例患者被随机分配至接受12个月5G-CTP随访（n = 104）或门诊护理（n = 102）。对于主要终点，即从临床事件到干预的时间，5G-CTP组的响应时间显著短于门诊组（4.2 vs. 11.5天；p < 0.001）。对于次要终点，基于明尼苏达心力衰竭生活质量问卷，5G-CTP组在12个月时生活质量改善更大（p = 0.012）。两组计划外就诊和临床干预的发生率相似，无手术相关并发症。该模式通过5G网络将社区医院与植入中心整合，使专科医生指导的护理能够在当地及时进行，无需长途旅行。这是ICD/CRT-D术后管理的一种可行策略，特别是在获得专科心脏护理机会有限的欠发达地区。

title: Clinical case: complete atrioventricular block in a young child
summary: Cardiac conduction disorder is one of the most complex challenges in pediatric cardiology. In young children, the most important issue is the presence of atrioventricular (AV) block, which manifests as an abnormal slowing (incomplete block) or cessation (complete block) of electrical impulse conduction from the atria to the ventricles. The most severe form is complete AV block, which requires urgent diagnosis and, as a rule, implantation of a permanent pacemaker (PM). The aim of this study is to present a clinical case of complete AV block in a young child. A retrospective analysis of the patient’s medical history was performed; the patient was under follow-up and treatment in the cardiovascular surgery department. At the age of 2 years and 11 months, during a routine medical examination, ECG revealed cardiac rhythm disturbances manifested as sinus arrhythmia, heart rate of 50 bpm, and AV block. Due to suspected of complete AV block, the patient was urgently hospitalized for further examination and treatment. Comprehensive laboratory and instrumental examination of the child revealed complete AV block along with signs of heart failure. Based on clinical indications, the girl underwent permanent pacemaker implantation surgery with subsequent dynamic monitoring. During follow-up ECG monitoring, the primary rhythm was registered as IC in DDD mode, predominantly atrial-synchronized mode (pacemaker rhythm percentage 99 %). Five months post-implantation, during a follow-up examination, the ECG revealed ventricularpaced rhythm with a heart rate of 100 beats per minute. After two years, 24-hour ECG monitoring revealed a pacemaker rhythm in DDD mode with a baseline ventricular stimulation rate of 70–145 impulses per minute. The spontaneous rhythm was sinus. Pacemaker rhythm percentage reached 99 %. Echocardiographic findings showed no chamber enlargement, with a left ventricular ejection fraction of 70 %. This clinical case of complete AV block in a young child serves to draw attention of pediatricians, pediatric cardiologists, and specialists to the particularities of clinical presentation, diagnosis, and management of this rare pathology.
journal: Vestnik of North-Eastern Federal University Medical Sciences

AI.tldr: 一例2岁11月龄幼儿因完全性房室传导阻滞伴心衰表现紧急入院，植入永久起搏器后随访两年，DDD模式起搏比例99%，左室射血分数70%，心腔无扩大。
AI.motivation: 儿童心脏传导障碍是儿科心脏病学的难点，幼儿完全性房室传导阻滞可致心衰甚至猝死，需紧急诊断并通常需植入永久起搏器；本文通过个案呈现其临床表现、诊断与起搏器管理特点，以提醒儿科及心电生理相关医师关注这一少见病变。
AI.method: 单例回顾性临床病例分析。对象为一名2岁11月龄女孩，常规体检时心电图发现窦性心律不齐、心率50次/分及房室传导阻滞，疑诊完全性房室传导阻滞后紧急住院。经实验室与器械检查确诊完全性房室传导阻滞并伴心力衰竭征象，据临床指征行永久起搏器植入，术后行动态随访（心电图、24小时动态心电图、超声心动图）。摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: 术后随访心电图示主要节律为DDD模式（IC），以心房同步模式为主，起搏器节律占比99%。植入后5个月随访心电图为心室起搏节律，心率100次/分。两年后24小时动态心电图示DDD模式起搏，基础心室刺激频率70–145次/分，自身节律为窦性，起搏节律占比99%。超声心动图示心腔无扩大，左室射血分数70%。摘要未报告并发症及统计学检验结果。
AI.conclusion: 该病例提示幼儿完全性房室传导阻滞可仅以心率减慢及房室传导阻滞为首发表现，需紧急评估是否合并心衰并尽早植入永久起搏器；术后DDD心房同步起搏比例高、心功能与心腔大小维持良好。对儿科医师而言，应提高对幼儿房室传导阻滞的识别与及时转诊意识。局限为单例报告、随访仅两年，缺乏对照与长期预后数据。
